items.title: 日本央行釋鷹派信號：通膨風險升溫 升息步伐或快於市場預期
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Signals Hawkish Stance: Inflation Risks Rise, Rate Hikes May Outpace Market Expectations
paras: 根據日本央行公布的 7 月政策會議意見摘要，日銀內部對通膨升溫風險的關注顯著提升。一名委員指出，鑑於核心消費者物價指數 (CPI) 已接近 2% 的目標，且物價上行風險較以往更高，日銀未來的升息步調可能會比市場預期的更快。
在該次會議中，日銀將政策利率維持在 1%，但明確釋放了 9 月可能進一步升息的訊號。
日銀委員呼籲應展現防止通膨向上偏離的決心，並主張採取更靈活的方法，根據海外金融環境的變化討論升息規模，而非固守特定的升息節奏。目前，政策焦點已從「將通膨提升至 2%」轉向「避免通膨進一步向上偏離」。
日元走勢是推動升息預期的關鍵因素。日元兌美元匯率上月跌至 40 年低點，加劇了進口型通膨的疑慮。市場參與者已開始反映提前升息的可能性，隔夜掉期交易顯示，9 月升息的機率約為三分之二，而 10 月前升息的機率則高達 96%。
日銀總裁植田和男在會後記者會中同樣展現鷹派色調，強調價格前景存在較大的上行風險。有委員認為，儘管目前難以精確判定「中性利率」(即既不刺激也不冷卻經濟的利率水準，日銀估計約在 1.1% 至 2.5% 之間)，但由於目前利率仍低於此範圍的下限，日銀有必要持續調升利率，為貨幣政策正常化奠定基礎。
未來，日銀稱將持續密切監控中東局勢、人工智慧 (AI) 需求及匯率變動對日本經濟的影響。
paras_en: According to the summary of the Bank of Japan’s July policy meeting, internal concern about rising inflation risk has increased markedly. One board member noted that, given the core consumer price index (CPI) is close to the 2% target and price‑upside risks are higher than before, the BOJ’s future rate‑hike pace could be faster than market expectations.
At the meeting, the BOJ kept its policy rate at 1% but clearly signaled that a further hike could come in September.

The BOJ member called for a firm resolve to prevent inflation from overshooting and advocated a more flexible approach, discussing the size of any hike in response to changes in the overseas financial environment rather than sticking to a preset rhythm. The policy focus has shifted from “lifting inflation to 2%” to “avoiding further upward deviation of inflation.”

The yen’s movement is a key driver of rate‑hike expectations. The yen fell to a 40‑year low against the dollar last month, heightening concerns about import‑driven inflation. Market participants have begun pricing in the possibility of an early hike; overnight swap markets show about a two‑thirds probability of a September hike and a 96% chance of a hike before October.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda also adopted a hawkish tone at the post‑meeting press conference, stressing that price outlooks carry significant upside risk. One member said that, although it is currently difficult to pinpoint the “neutral rate” (the rate that neither stimulates nor cools the economy, which the BOJ estimates at roughly 1.1%‑2.5%), the present rate is still below the lower bound of that range, so the BOJ needs to keep raising rates to lay the groundwork for monetary‑policy normalization.
Going forward, the BOJ said it will continue to closely monitor the impact of Middle‑East developments, artificial‑intelligence (AI) demand and exchange‑rate movements on the Japanese economy.

items.title: 黃仁勳罕見開口挺AI開源！一封公開信炸出矽谷「開源vs閉源」兩大陣營博弈
items.title_en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang Rarely Speaks Out in Support of AI Open-Source, Sparking a Valley-Wide Debate on Open-Source vs Closed-Source
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳罕見聲援「開放權重」AI 模型，短短數天便吸引 70 多家企業與 AI 業界人士聯署，讓開放與封閉模型兩大陣營正式浮上檯面。這場看似技術路線之爭，背後其實牽動晶片、雲端、模型與 AI 應用的利益重新分配。
一向低調、鮮少在社群媒體上表態的黃仁勳，日前罕見地在 X 上發出他個人的第一則貼文，內容直接聲援一封題為《開放權重與美國 AI 領導力》（Open Weights and American AI Leadership）的聯署公開信。
這封信在短短數天內，聯署企業數量便從最初的 25 家暴增至 70 餘家，累積閱讀量突破 6000 萬次，也讓外界首次清楚看見，矽谷 AI 產業在「開放模型」與「封閉模型」兩條路線上，已形成壁壘分明的兩大陣營。
這封公開信的訴求相當直接：呼籲業界共同支持「開放權重」模型的發展，並反對監管單位對開源 AI 模型採取一刀切式的限制。
分析指出，這表面上看似只是一次產業倡議，但實際上內容直指幾個關鍵議題，包括防止新創企業被單一模型供應商綁定、將競爭從模型層擴大到雲端與晶片層、主張技術透明度有助於安全治理，以及為「知識蒸餾」（利用大型模型的輸出訓練較小模型）技術辯護，強調這是研究上行之有年的正當做法，不應被視為侵權或竊取。
信中傳達的核心立場，可以歸納為一句話：監管機構不應該為了防範尚未發生的風險，而限制開放權重這條技術路線的發展空間。
微軟 (MSFT-US) 執行長納德拉（Satya Nadella）、特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 執行長馬斯克、圖靈獎得主楊立昆（Yann LeCun），以及 AI 學者吳恩達（Andrew Ng）等重量級人物皆列名聲援，陣容堪稱近年 AI 圈規模最大的一次集體表態。

各懷盤算：誰在支持開源，為了什麼

觀察這份聯署名單背後的企業組成，不難發現這其實是一場關於 AI 產業鏈利潤分配的角力，各方支持開源都有各自的商業考量。
晶片與硬體廠商如輝達、戴爾科技 (DELL-US) ，最在意的是算力需求能否持續擴張。當愈來愈多企業選擇自行部署與微調開放權重模型，硬體採購與雲端算力的需求也會隨之水漲船高，這正是輝達力挺開源的根本動機。
微軟、Palantir(PLTR-US) 等雲端服務與企業軟體業者，則希望藉由開放權重模型豐富自家雲端平台的產品線，讓企業客戶不必被單一 API 供應商綁定，進而把客戶留在自己的雲端與訂閱服務生態中。
以 Meta(META-US) 為首的開源陣營與生態基礎設施業者，則是希望透過開放模型（如 Llama 系列）掌握技術標準的主導權；Mistral、Hugging Face 等新創公司也藉此爭取原本被閉源巨頭壟斷的企業客戶。
而創投圈如 a16z、YC 等機構，則擔心若底層模型長期被少數閉源公司把持，應用層新創的獲利空間將被大幅壓縮，因此力挺開放權重，以確保新創公司在成本與商業模式上仍有議價空間。

Anthropic 缺席聯署 立場鮮明成為焦點

值得注意的是，在這波近乎「集體站隊」的聲勢中，Anthropic 的缺席格外顯眼。
作為閉源陣營的代表性企業，Anthropic 不僅未加入聯署，其員工 Julian 更在 X 上公開對開源陣營表達不以為然的態度，直接引發吳恩達的回應。
吳恩達表示，任何公司都有權利選擇不公開自己的程式碼，但沒有立場去阻止其他人選擇開源。
外界普遍認為，Anthropic 對開放權重的保留態度，與其商業模式高度相關。
該公司的營收與估值，很大程度建立在模型能力的稀缺性之上。一旦市場上出現足以替代的開源模型，其 API 訂價的溢價空間與資本市場對其成長性的想像，都可能受到衝擊。而監管政策未來如何拿捏，也仍是開源陣營必須持續面對的變數。

模型走向「基礎設施化」，應用層成新戰場

分析稱，隨著開源模型的性能持續逼近甚至部分超越閉源模型，業界觀察普遍認為，底層大型語言模型正逐漸「基礎設施化」，也就是逐漸成為低成本、高普及的公共資源，單靠堆疊參數規模已難以構成長期競爭優勢。
在這樣的趨勢下，產業利潤可能會朝兩端集中：一端是輝達等掌握運算基礎設施的硬體廠商；另一端則是能將 AI 技術與企業真實資料、業務流程及智慧代理（Agent）深度結合的應用層公司。
與此同時，企業客戶對資料主權與技術安全性的重視程度提高，也讓「參數規模較小、可私有化部署、性能貼近實際需求」的垂直領域模型，加上端側運算裝置（如 AI PC、AI 手機）的普及，被部分業界人士視為下一階段較具確定性的商業化方向。
這場開放與封閉路線之爭，短期內恐怕難有定論。但對整個 AI 產業而言，這場公開的路線辯論，某種程度上也標誌著這個產業正式告別野蠻生長的早期階段，進入規則與利益重新分配的新局面。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang has rarely spoken out in support of open-source AI models, but his recent endorsement has sparked a valley-wide debate on open-source vs closed-source.
Huang, who is usually low-key and rarely speaks out on social media, recently posted a rare message on X in support of an open letter titled 'Open Weights and American AI Leadership'.

The open letter, which has gained over 60 million reads in a short span of time, has seen the number of signatories jump from 25 to over 70, making it clear that the AI industry in Silicon Valley has formed two distinct camps: open-source and closed-source.

The open letter's demands are straightforward: it calls on the industry to support the development of open-source models and opposes regulatory bodies from imposing blanket restrictions on open-source AI models.

Analysts point out that this seemingly technical debate actually touches on several key issues, including preventing startups from being locked into a single model provider, expanding competition from the model layer to the cloud and chip layers, advocating for transparency in technology to improve governance, and defending the use of 'knowledge distillation' (training smaller models using the output of large models) as a legitimate research practice.
The core stance of the open letter can be summed up in one sentence: regulatory bodies should not restrict the development of open-source models to prevent potential risks that have not yet occurred.

Microsoft (MSFT-US) CEO Satya Nadella, Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk, Turing Award winner Yann LeCun, and AI expert Andrew Ng, among others, have signed the open letter, making it one of the largest collective statements in the AI community in recent years.
The signatories' motivations are varied, with each having their own commercial considerations.
Chip and hardware manufacturers like NVIDIA and Dell (DELL-US) are concerned about whether the demand for computing power will continue to grow.

Microsoft, Palantir (PLTR-US), and other cloud service and enterprise software providers hope to enrich their cloud platforms with open-source models, allowing customers to avoid being locked into a single API provider and keeping customers within their cloud and subscription services ecosystem.

The open-source camp, led by Meta (META-US), hopes to control the standards of technology through open models (such as the Llama series); startups like Mistral and Hugging Face also seek to win over customers from closed-source giants.

Venture capital firms like a16z and YC are concerned that if the underlying models are controlled by a few closed-source companies, the profit space for application-layer startups will be significantly compressed, so they support open-source to ensure that startups have room for negotiation on costs and business models.
Anthropic's absence from the open letter has become a focal point, with its employees expressing skepticism about the open-source camp.
Andrew Ng responded that any company has the right to choose not to open-source its code, but it has no right to prevent others from doing so.
The external community believes that Anthropic's cautious attitude towards open-source is closely related to its business model, which relies heavily on the scarcity of model capabilities.

Anthropic's revenue and valuation are largely based on the scarcity of model capabilities. If open-source models appear in the market, the API pricing premium and the capital market's imagination of its growth potential may be affected.
The regulatory policy in the future will also be a variable that the open-source camp must continue to face.

As open-source models continue to approach and even surpass closed-source models in performance, the industry has come to a consensus that large language models are gradually 'infrastructure-izing', becoming low-cost and widely available public resources, and relying solely on parameter scale is no longer a long-term competitive advantage.

In this trend, industry profits may concentrate at both ends: one end is held by chip manufacturers like NVIDIA, and the other end is held by companies that can deeply integrate AI technology with enterprise real data, business processes, and intelligent agents.

At the same time, the importance of data sovereignty and technical security for enterprise customers has increased, making vertical domain models with smaller parameters, private deployment, and performance close to actual needs, as well as edge computing devices (such as AI PCs and AI phones), a more certain commercial direction in the next stage.

This open-source vs closed-source debate may not have a clear conclusion in the short term, but it marks the beginning of the AI industry's transition from a wild-growth early stage to a stage with rules and interest redistribution.

items.title: 鑽石投資領投新析2000萬美元增資完成 加速空間蛋白質體學發展
items.title_en: Diamond Investment Leads Syncell's $20 Million A+ Round, Accelerating Spatial Proteomics Development
paras: 鑽石投資 (6901-TW) 與新析生技 (Syncell) 今 (10) 日宣布，由鑽石領投的新析 2000 萬美元 A + 輪增資案順利完成，有助新析在空間蛋白質體學，加速平台技術發展與全球商化布局。
鑽石投資總經理路孔明表示，自 2023 年開始投資新析，並持續以最大法人股東支持公司發展。近兩年新析設備銷售與營收倍數成長，並建立涵蓋美洲、歐洲、亞洲的銷售團隊與合作網絡，此次增資案將有助新析以特有平台技術，加速推進在全球創新研究與新藥開發合作，並擴大國際市場商業化規模。
新析生技開發的蛋白質光標靶儀 (Microscoop) 為具備抓取能力的自動化 AI 顯微鏡系統，可在奈米級空間找出 1000 種以上的全新生物標記物，縮短阿茲海默症、癌症等新藥研發的靶點探索時程。
執行長廖仲麒表示，空間蛋白質體學已成為新一代生命科學研究的工具，Microscoop 可協助研究單位以較佳的解析度探索疾病機制、加速新藥開發，目前已應用於神經退化疾病以及癌症等複雜疾病研究
廖仲麒進一步提到， Microscoop 目前獲多家國際藥廠及研究機構採用，並已與全球生技儀器設備商 Thermo Fisher Scientific 建立策略合作。未來將持續推出分析速度更快、解析度更高的新一代產品，提升研究效率並拓展應用範圍。
paras_en: Diamond Investment (6901-TW) and Syncell announced today that Diamond Investment-led Syncell's $20 million A+ round has been successfully completed, helping Syncell accelerate its spatial proteomics development, platform technology development, and global commercialization.

Diamond Investment's General Manager, Lu Kongming, stated that Diamond Investment has been investing in Syncell since 2023 and has continuously supported the company's development as its largest shareholder. Over the past two years, Syncell's equipment sales and revenue have grown exponentially, and the company has established a sales team and cooperation network covering the Americas, Europe, and Asia. This round of financing will help Syncell accelerate its global innovation research and new drug development collaborations and expand its international commercialization scale.

Syncell's developed Microscoop is an automated AI microscope system capable of capturing 1,000 or more novel biomarkers in nanoscale space, shortening the exploration time for new drug targets in diseases such as Alzheimer's and cancer.

CEO Liao Zhongqi stated that spatial proteomics has become a tool for the next-generation life science research, and Microscoop can help research units explore disease mechanisms with higher resolution and accelerate new drug development. It has been applied to research on complex diseases such as neurodegenerative diseases and cancer.

Liao Zhongqi further stated that Microscoop has been adopted by multiple international pharmaceutical companies and research institutions and has established a strategic cooperation with global biotech instrument and equipment company Thermo Fisher Scientific. In the future, it will continue to launch new-generation products with faster analysis speed and higher resolution, improving research efficiency and expanding application scope.

items.title: 國票金高管年薪衝破2000萬引關注！大股東一銀開第一槍促董事會檢討
items.title_en: Nationwide Commercial Bank Executives' Salaries Exceed NT$20 Million, Sparking Concerns!
paras: 對近期外界高度關注國票金控 (2889-TW) 高階主管薪酬議題，大股東之一的第一銀行今（10）日發表聲明出手表態。一銀表示，身為投資股東，已促請所推舉之國票金控董事，透過董事會針對國票金及其子公司之薪酬結構進行合理性檢討，並期盼國票金持續精進公司治理，以保障股東權益。
國票金控今年 5 月底完成董事改選，經營權由民營金控轉變為公股主導，但高階主管薪酬並未同步調整為公股金融機構水準，進而產生落差。依據國票金 2025 年底年報揭露，董事長魏啟林年薪達 2622 萬元、副董事長何志強 2030 萬元、總經理陳冠舟 1918 萬元；子公司國票證券與國際票券董總年薪亦達千萬元至 3000 萬元不等。
一銀為國票金主要股東之一，目前指派張兆順、周慶輝及蔡淑慧等 3 名董事，其中張兆順為現任國票金董事長。一銀此次開出檢討第一槍，要求回歸合理性，後續薪酬結構調整將成為金融圈關注焦點。
財政部早於 2010 年 3 月 23 日 即訂定頒布《財政部派任或推薦至公股民營事業及其轉投資事業之董事長總經理薪資標準規範》，並於 2022 年（民國 111 年）3 月 23 日 進行修正，據以管理所有公股董總的薪酬水準。
paras_en: Major shareholder First Bank has spoken out on the recent controversy surrounding the high salaries of Nationwide Commercial Bank's (2889-TW) top executives. First Bank stated that as an investor, it has urged the directors it has nominated to Nationwide Commercial Bank to review the company's compensation structure through the board of directors and ensure that it is reasonable.

Nationwide Commercial Bank completed its board of directors reshuffle in late May, with the operating rights transitioning from private to public ownership. However, the high salaries of top executives have not been adjusted to match those of public financial institutions, resulting in a disparity. According to Nationwide Commercial Bank's 2025 year-end report, Chairman Wei Qi Lin's annual salary was NT$262.2 million, Vice Chairman He Zhi Qiang's was NT$203 million, and General Manager Chen Guan Zhou's was NT$191.8 million. The CEOs of its subsidiaries, Nationwide Securities and International Securities, also earned NT$1 billion to NT$3 billion annually.

First Bank, a major shareholder of Nationwide Commercial Bank, has appointed three directors, including current Chairman Zhang Zhao Shun. First Bank has fired the first shot, calling for a return to reason and a subsequent adjustment to the compensation structure, which will become a focus of attention in the financial sector.

The Ministry of Finance established the 'Regulations for the Salaries of Chairmen and General Managers of Public and Private Enterprises and Their Subsidiaries' on March 23, 2010, and revised it on March 23, 2022, to manage the salaries of all public CEOs.

items.title: 〈台股盤後〉台達電漲停領軍漲702點站回季線 但4萬5得而復失
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market: TSMC Weighs Down Market, but TSMC Leads the Charge with 702.85 Point Gain
paras: 台股今 (10) 日在電源雙雄、聯電及日月光投控、記憶體族群強漲帶動，一度重返 45000 點之上，雖然尾盤受到台積電下壓影響，漲點略收斂，但仍上漲 702.85 點，收 44928.76 點，站回季線之上，成交值 8474 億元。
觀察今日權值股表日，台積電 (2330-TW) 最後一盤 4381 張賣單壓盤，僅小漲 10 元或 0.42%，收最低 2480 元，聯發科 (2454-TW) 及鴻海 (2317-TW)、台光電 (2383-TW) 等小漲 1%、聯電 (2303-TW) 漲 6%。
電源雙雄台達電 (2308-TW)、光寶 (2301-TW) 漲停，封測指標日月光投控 (3711-TW) 漲 7.7%，力成 (6239-TW) 漲停，友達 (2409-TW) 傳出台中廠獲台積電有意購買、攻上漲停，群創 (3481-TW) 也同步亮燈。
記憶體族群表現同樣強勢，南亞科 (2408-TW)、華邦電 (2344-TW)、旺宏 (2337-TW) 均漲停，半導體通路雙雄文曄 (3036-TW) 漲 8%、大聯大 (3702-TW) 漲逾 6%，聯茂 (6213-TW) 也漲停。
高價電子股方面，川湖 (2059-TW) 盤中一度漲停續創新天價，收盤上漲 7%，新代 (7750-TW) 漲 6%，但健策 (3653-TW) 逆勢下跌逾 5%，勤誠 (8210-TW)、智邦 (2345-TW) 跌 2-3%，金像電 (2368-TW) 跌 5.7%。

paras_en: The Taiwan stock market today (10) was driven by the strong performance of the power supply giants, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) and United Microelectronics Corporation (UMC), as well as the memory sector, which led to a surge in the market, reaching as high as 45,000 points. items.title: 估值回歸健康水位！高盛：中國AI無泡沫 三大細分領域最具投資價值
items.title_en: Valuation Returns to Healthy Levels! Goldman Sachs: China AI Has No Bubble, Three Sub-Fields Most Valuable for Investment
paras: 近來，全球 AI 類股因基建投資可持續性與估值過高疑慮震盪加劇，半導體等 AI 概念股自高點大幅回調，但高盛首席中國股票策略師劉勁津最新表態，中國 AI 族群並不存在整體性泡沫，近期修正反令估值回歸健康水平，並看好三大細分領域投資機會。
劉勁津在接受媒體採訪時指出，中國 AI 相關股票總市值尚未充分反映這項技術對整體經濟的潛在紅利。
他坦言，今年 6 月 A 股確實出現局部過熱。科創板與創業板部分 AI 硬體公司估值一度觸及五年高點，但隨後股價回落與獲利預期調整，目前已重新達成動態平衡，估值步入「合理健康」區間。
數據顯示，中國 AI 企業目前約佔全球 AI 類股總市值的 11%，但海外資金 AI 投資組合中配置到中國 AI 類股的部位僅約 1%。
高盛據此判斷，外資對中國 AI 類股的低配程度極高，意味著後續存在顯著的加碼空間與估值修復潛力。
高盛還明確點名三大最具投資價值的 AI 細分領域：首先是電力供應鏈，AI 資料中心能耗激增將持續推高電力設備與能源管理需求；其次是硬體基礎設施，涵蓋算力晶片、伺服器、光模塊及液冷散熱等核心環節；第三是物理 AI，即 AI 與機器人、自動化設備的深度融合，這被視為繼大模型之後的下一個產業落地爆發點。
市場分析認為，儘管短期受全球風險偏好波動影響，但中國 AI 產業鏈在應用場景、工程化能力與製造配套上的優勢依然明確。高盛「低配」判斷與「三大賽道」指引，為市場提供了重要的逆向佈局參考。隨著今年下半年獲利驗證期到來，具備真實業績兌現能力的標的有望率先走出估值窪地。
paras_en: Recently, global AI-related stocks have been shaken by concerns over sustainable investment and overvaluation, with semiconductor and AI-concept stocks experiencing a sharp decline from their highs. However, Goldman Sachs' chief China equity strategist, Liu Jingjin, has stated that China's AI sector does not have a systemic bubble, and the recent correction has brought valuations back to a healthy level, with a positive outlook for investment opportunities in three sub-fields.
Liu Jingjin pointed out in an interview that the total market value of China's AI-related stocks has not yet fully reflected the potential benefits of this technology on the overall economy.

He admitted that there was a local overheating in the A-share market in June this year. Some AI hardware companies on the Science and Technology Innovation Board and the Growth Enterprise Board had their valuations reach a five-year high, but the stock prices subsequently fell and earnings expectations were adjusted, and the valuations have now returned to a dynamic balance, entering the 'reasonable and healthy' zone.

Data shows that China's AI companies currently account for about 11% of the total market value of global AI-related stocks, but overseas funds have only allocated about 1% of their AI investment portfolios to China's AI-related stocks.

Goldman Sachs believes that the low allocation of foreign capital to China's AI-related stocks is extremely high, indicating that there is a significant potential for subsequent additions and valuation repairs.

Goldman Sachs has also identified three sub-fields with the most investment value: first, the power supply chain, where AI data centers will continue to drive up demand for power equipment and energy management; second, hardware infrastructure, covering core components such as computing chips, servers, optical modules, and liquid cooling heat dissipation; third, physical AI, which refers to the deep integration of AI and robotics, automation equipment, and is seen as the next industry landing explosion point after large models.

Market analysis believes that although the short-term is affected by the fluctuation of global risk preferences, China's AI industry chain still has clear advantages in application scenarios, engineering capabilities, and manufacturing support. Goldman Sachs' 'low allocation' judgment and 'three-track' guidance provide important references for market reverse layout. As the second-half earnings verification period approaches, companies with real performance realization capabilities are expected to be the first to emerge from the valuation trough.

items.title: 罕見！美財長貝森特多管齊下力阻長債殖利率攀升 華爾街嗅到政策訊號
items.title_en: Rare Move! US Treasury Secretary Yellen Takes a Multi-Pronged Approach to Curb Long-Term Bond Yield Rise, Wall Street Picks Up Policy Signals
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，美國財長貝森特正打出一套罕見組合拳，試圖掐住長端美債殖利率繼續急升的趨勢。
過去一週，在 30 年期美債殖利率觸及 19 年高點、10 年期站上 4.6% 區間後，貝森特接連出招，被交易員解讀為「財政部對長端利率感到焦慮」的明確信號。
上月底，美國自 1998 年來首度聯手日本買入日元，表面撐匯市，實則堵住日本為籌美元護盤而拋售美債的缺口。貝森特還提示東京可動用聯儲 SRF 融資機制，降低變賣美債壓力。
第二步是發債指引「微整形」。在上週季度再融資聲明中，美國財政部將長天期附息債發行前瞻由「增加 (increases)」改為「調整 (changes)」，市場普遍視為替未來削減 20 年、30 年期供給留後門。
第三步是輿論戰。貝森特近日頻上電視、發社群，為聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許模糊的通膨溝通策略護航，緩解「政策不透明→期限溢價飆升」的惡性循環。
摩根資產管理投資組合經理 Priya Misra 指出，Fed 與財政部必然擔心長端水位，
Misra 說，「干預日元、力挺華許、暗示減長債供給，都是在告訴市場：他們看見了且不惜用盡工具」，但他指出，年赤字近 2 兆美元、通膨黏性未消，新債供給只增不減，財長影響力有天花板。
對白宮而言，壓低房貸與企業融資成本是直接政治任務。美國財政部發言人未回應置評，但市場已接收到訊號，貝森特不想重演「長債失控」劇本，哪怕只能買到幾十個基點的緩衝。
paras_en: According to the latest reports from abroad, US Treasury Secretary Yellen is playing a rare combination of cards in an attempt to curb the rising trend of long-term US bond yields.

In the past week, after the 30-year US bond yield touched a 19-year high and the 10-year yield rose to the 4.6% range, Yellen has taken a series of measures, which traders interpreted as a clear signal that the Treasury Department is concerned about long-term interest rates.

At the end of last month, the US and Japan jointly purchased yen for the first time since 1998, ostensibly to support the foreign exchange market, but in reality to block Japan's sale of US bonds to defend the dollar. Yellen also hinted that Tokyo could use the liquidity provision mechanism of the Bank of Japan's SRF to reduce the pressure of selling US bonds.

The second step is the 'micro-adjustment' of the debt issuance guidelines. In the quarterly refinancing statement last week, the US Treasury Department changed the outlook for long-term bond issuance from 'increases' to 'changes', which the market widely interpreted as a signal to reduce the supply of 20-year and 30-year bonds in the future.

The third step is the public relations campaign. Yellen has recently appeared on TV and social media to defend the Fed's Chairman Powell's ambiguous communication strategy on inflation, aiming to break the vicious cycle of 'policy opacity -> term premium explosion'.
Priya Misra, investment portfolio manager at Morgan Asset Management, pointed out that the Fed and the Treasury Department must be concerned about the long-term level.

Misra said, 'Intervening in the yen, supporting Powell, and hinting at reducing long-term bond supply, are all telling the market: they see it and are willing to use all tools.' However, he pointed out that with a budget deficit of nearly $2 trillion and sticky inflation, new bond supply only increases, and the Treasury Secretary's influence has a ceiling.

For the White House, lowering mortgage and corporate borrowing costs is a direct political task. The US Treasury Department spokesperson did not respond to a request for comment, but the market has already received the signal that Yellen does not want to repeat the 'long bond out of control' script, even if it's just a few dozen basis points of buffer.

items.title: 日企高層警告：日元貶值與匯率波動加劇進口成本壓力
items.title_en: Japanese Corporate Leaders Warn: Yen Depreciation and Exchange Rate Volatility Exacerbate Import Cost Pressure
paras: 日本企業界正對日元持續走弱及其劇烈波動表達日益強烈的擔憂，這也反映了上週促使美日兩國採取聯合干預行動以支撐匯率的背景。雖然出口商通常受益於日元貶值，但目前的匯率環境正對日本這個高度仰賴進口的經濟體造成沉重負擔。
今年 7 月，日元兌美元匯率一度觸及近 164 的 40 年低點，隨後引發干預使日元反彈約 5%。三菱電機 (Mitsubishi Electric) 財務長 Yoshihiro Shimazu 直言：「日元疲軟並不代表一切順遂。」
他指出，能源、原材料與食品成本的上漲正在壓抑國內需求，威脅日本緩步走出長達數十年通縮的進程。
日本貿易振興機構 (JETRO) 主席 Norihiko Ishiguro 也指出，由於日本企業幾乎所有原物料皆需進口，當匯率貶至特定水準時，成本增加將使出口商不再是贏家。
為應對挑戰，Uniqlo 母公司迅銷 (Fast Retailing) 預計將日本部分秋冬商品價格調漲約 4% 以抵消日元跌幅；無印良品 (Muji) 則試圖透過加強內部生產而非僅靠漲價來維持利潤。
此外，劇烈的匯率波動也干擾了跨國企業的獲利預測與投資決策。三井物產 (Mitsui & Co) 與三菱商事 (Mitsubishi Corp) 均強調，市場高度波動對經營造成極大影響，企業必須適時修正其匯率假設。
根據調查，雖然約兩成日企認為 120 至 124 日元是最理想的區間，但業界對此並不樂觀，認為在日本基本面未改善且貿易平衡未恢復的情況下，恐難再見到 120 至 130 的水準。
paras_en: Japanese corporate leaders are increasingly concerned about the yen's persistent weakness and sharp fluctuations, reflecting the background that led to the joint intervention by the US and Japan last week to support the exchange rate. Although exporters typically benefit from a weaker yen, the current exchange rate environment is putting a heavy burden on Japan's economy, which relies heavily on imports.

In July, the yen's exchange rate against the dollar briefly touched a 40-year low of nearly 164, prompting intervention that caused the yen to rebound by about 5%. Mitsubishi Electric's CFO Yoshihiro Shimazu said, 'A weak yen does not mean everything is going smoothly.'
He pointed out that rising energy, raw materials, and food costs are suppressing domestic demand, threatening Japan's slow recovery from decades-long deflation.

JETRO Chairman Norihiko Ishiguro also pointed out that since almost all of Japan's raw materials need to be imported, when the exchange rate falls to a certain level, increased costs will make exporters no longer the winners.

To cope with the challenges, Fast Retailing, the parent company of Uniqlo, plans to raise the prices of some of its Japanese autumn and winter products by about 4% to offset the yen's decline; Muji is trying to maintain its profits by strengthening its internal production rather than just raising prices.

In addition, the sharp fluctuations in the exchange rate are also disrupting multinational companies' profit forecasts and investment decisions. Mitsui & Co and Mitsubishi Corp both emphasized that market volatility has a huge impact on their operations, and companies must adjust their exchange rate assumptions in a timely manner.

According to a survey, although about 20% of Japanese companies believe that the ideal range is between 120 and 124 yen, the industry is not optimistic, believing that it will be difficult to see a level of 120 to 130 yen again, given that the underlying fundamentals in Japan have not improved and the trade balance has not been restored.

items.title: 鑽石投資領投新析2000萬美元增資完成 加速空間蛋白質體學發展
items.title_en: Diamond Investment Leads Syncell's $20 Million A+ Round, Accelerating Spatial Proteomics Development
paras: 鑽石投資 (6901-TW) 與新析生技 (Syncell) 今 (10) 日宣布，由鑽石領投的新析 2000 萬美元 A + 輪增資案順利完成，有助新析在空間蛋白質體學，加速平台技術發展與全球商化布局。
鑽石投資總經理路孔明表示，自 2023 年開始投資新析，並持續以最大法人股東支持公司發展。近兩年新析設備銷售與營收倍數成長，並建立涵蓋美洲、歐洲、亞洲的銷售團隊與合作網絡，此次增資案將有助新析以特有平台技術，加速推進在全球創新研究與新藥開發合作，並擴大國際市場商業化規模。
新析生技開發的蛋白質光標靶儀 (Microscoop) 為具備抓取能力的自動化 AI 顯微鏡系統，可在奈米級空間找出 1000 種以上的全新生物標記物，縮短阿茲海默症、癌症等新藥研發的靶點探索時程。
執行長廖仲麒表示，空間蛋白質體學已成為新一代生命科學研究的工具，Microscoop 可協助研究單位以較佳的解析度探索疾病機制、加速新藥開發，目前已應用於神經退化疾病以及癌症等複雜疾病研究
廖仲麒進一步提到， Microscoop 目前獲多家國際藥廠及研究機構採用，並已與全球生技儀器設備商 Thermo Fisher Scientific 建立策略合作。未來將持續推出分析速度更快、解析度更高的新一代產品，提升研究效率並拓展應用範圍。
paras_en: Diamond Investment (6901-TW) and Syncell announced today that Diamond Investment-led Syncell's $20 million A+ round has been successfully completed, helping Syncell accelerate its spatial proteomics development, platform technology development, and global commercialization.

Diamond Investment's General Manager, Lu Kongming, stated that Diamond Investment has been investing in Syncell since 2023 and has continuously supported the company's development as its largest shareholder. Over the past two years, Syncell's equipment sales and revenue have grown exponentially, and the company has established a sales team and cooperation network covering the Americas, Europe, and Asia. This round of financing will help Syncell accelerate its global innovation research and new drug development collaborations and expand its international commercialization scale.

Syncell's developed Microscoop is an automated AI microscope system capable of capturing 1,000 or more novel biomarkers in nanoscale space, shortening the exploration time for new drug targets in diseases such as Alzheimer's and cancer.

CEO Liao Zhongqi stated that spatial proteomics has become a tool for the next-generation life science research, and Microscoop can help research units explore disease mechanisms with higher resolution and accelerate new drug development. It has been applied to research on complex diseases such as neurodegenerative diseases and cancer.

Liao Zhongqi further stated that Microscoop has been adopted by multiple international pharmaceutical companies and research institutions and has established a strategic cooperation with global biotech instrument and equipment company Thermo Fisher Scientific. In the future, it will continue to launch new-generation products with faster analysis speed and higher resolution, improving research efficiency and expanding application scope.

items.title: 國票金高管年薪衝破2000萬引關注！大股東一銀開第一槍促董事會檢討
items.title_en: Nationwide Commercial Bank Executives' Salaries Exceed NT$20 Million, Sparking Concerns!
paras: 對近期外界高度關注國票金控 (2889-TW) 高階主管薪酬議題，大股東之一的第一銀行今（10）日發表聲明出手表態。一銀表示，身為投資股東，已促請所推舉之國票金控董事，透過董事會針對國票金及其子公司之薪酬結構進行合理性檢討，並期盼國票金持續精進公司治理，以保障股東權益。
國票金控今年 5 月底完成董事改選，經營權由民營金控轉變為公股主導，但高階主管薪酬並未同步調整為公股金融機構水準，進而產生落差。依據國票金 2025 年底年報揭露，董事長魏啟林年薪達 2622 萬元、副董事長何志強 2030 萬元、總經理陳冠舟 1918 萬元；子公司國票證券與國際票券董總年薪亦達千萬元至 3000 萬元不等。
一銀為國票金主要股東之一，目前指派張兆順、周慶輝及蔡淑慧等 3 名董事，其中張兆順為現任國票金董事長。一銀此次開出檢討第一槍，要求回歸合理性，後續薪酬結構調整將成為金融圈關注焦點。
財政部早於 2010 年 3 月 23 日 即訂定頒布《財政部派任或推薦至公股民營事業及其轉投資事業之董事長總經理薪資標準規範》，並於 2022 年（民國 111 年）3 月 23 日 進行修正，據以管理所有公股董總的薪酬水準。
paras_en: Major shareholder First Bank has spoken out on the recent controversy surrounding the high salaries of Nationwide Commercial Bank's (2889-TW) top executives. First Bank stated that as an investor, it has urged the directors it has nominated to Nationwide Commercial Bank to review the company's compensation structure through the board of directors and ensure that it is reasonable.

Nationwide Commercial Bank completed its board of directors reshuffle in late May, with the operating rights transitioning from private to public ownership. However, the high salaries of top executives have not been adjusted to match those of public financial institutions, resulting in a disparity. According to Nationwide Commercial Bank's 2025 year-end report, Chairman Wei Qi Lin's annual salary was NT$262.2 million, Vice Chairman He Zhi Qiang's was NT$203 million, and General Manager Chen Guan Zhou's was NT$191.8 million. The CEOs of its subsidiaries, Nationwide Securities and International Securities, also earned NT$1 billion to NT$3 billion annually.

First Bank, a major shareholder of Nationwide Commercial Bank, has appointed three directors, including current Chairman Zhang Zhao Shun. First Bank has fired the first shot, calling for a return to reason and a subsequent adjustment to the compensation structure, which will become a focus of attention in the financial sector.

The Ministry of Finance established the 'Regulations for the Salaries of Chairmen and General Managers of Public and Private Enterprises and Their Subsidiaries' on March 23, 2010, and revised it on March 23, 2022, to manage the salaries of all public CEOs.

items.title: 〈台股盤後〉台達電漲停領軍漲702點站回季線 但4萬5得而復失
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market: TSMC Weighs Down Market, but TSMC Leads the Charge with 702.85 Point Gain
paras: 台股今 (10) 日在電源雙雄、聯電及日月光投控、記憶體族群強漲帶動，一度重返 45000 點之上，雖然尾盤受到台積電下壓影響，漲點略收斂，但仍上漲 702.85 點，收 44928.76 點，站回季線之上，成交值 8474 億元。
觀察今日權值股表日，台積電 (2330-TW) 最後一盤 4381 張賣單壓盤，僅小漲 10 元或 0.42%，收最低 2480 元，聯發科 (2454-TW) 及鴻海 (2317-TW)、台光電 (2383-TW) 等小漲 1%、聯電 (2303-TW) 漲 6%。
電源雙雄台達電 (2308-TW)、光寶 (2301-TW) 漲停，封測指標日月光投控 (3711-TW) 漲 7.7%，力成 (6239-TW) 漲停，友達 (2409-TW) 傳出台中廠獲台積電有意購買、攻上漲停，群創 (3481-TW) 也同步亮燈。
記憶體族群表現同樣強勢，南亞科 (2408-TW)、華邦電 (2344-TW)、旺宏 (2337-TW) 均漲停，半導體通路雙雄文曄 (3036-TW) 漲 8%、大聯大 (3702-TW) 漲逾 6%，聯茂 (6213-TW) 也漲停。
高價電子股方面，川湖 (2059-TW) 盤中一度漲停續創新天價，收盤上漲 7%，新代 (7750-TW) 漲 6%，但健策 (3653-TW) 逆勢下跌逾 5%，勤誠 (8210-TW)、智邦 (2345-TW) 跌 2-3%，金像電 (2368-TW) 跌 5.7%。
非電族群來看，華新 (1605-TW) 收漲停表現強勢，藥華藥 (6446-TW) 無懼與國際藥廠 AOP 仲裁案利空影響，收漲 7%；不過，華航 (2610-TW) 第二季獲利受到國際油價飆漲影響大減，股價重挫 9%，長榮航 (2618-TW) 也收跌近 4%。
paras_en: The Taiwan stock market today (10) was driven by the strong performance of the power supply giants, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) and United Microelectronics Corporation (UMC), as well as the memory sector, which led to a surge in the market, reaching as high as 45,000 points. Although the market was affected by TSMC's decline in the afternoon, the overall gain was still 702.85 points, closing at 44,928.76 points, above the season's high, with a trading value of NT$ 84.74 trillion.

Looking at the value stocks today, TSMC (2330-TW) had a sell order of 4,381 shares in the last trading session, resulting in a small gain of 10 NT dollars or 0.42%, closing at NT$ 24,800, while MediaTek (2454-TW) and Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., Ltd. (2317-TW), Taiwan Glass Industry Corp. (2383-TW), and United Microelectronics Corporation (2303-TW) gained 1%, and UMC gained 6%.

The power supply giants, TSMC (2308-TW) and Lite-On Technology Corp. (2301-TW), surged to the daily limit, while the testing and packaging company, Foxconn (3711-TW), gained 7.7%, and Powerchip Technology Corp. (6239-TW) also reached the daily limit. Foxconn announced that it has received an intention from TSMC to purchase its factory in Taichung, leading to a surge in its stock price, which also reached the daily limit. Winbond Electronics Corp. (3481-TW) also lit up the market.

The memory sector also performed strongly, with Nanya Technology Corp. (2408-TW), Winbond Electronics Corp. (2344-TW), and Winbond Electronics Corp. (2337-TW) all reaching the daily limit, while the semiconductor channel giants, Winbond Electronics Corp. (3036-TW), gained 8%, and United Microelectronics Corporation (3702-TW) gained over 6%, and Winbond Electronics Corp. (6213-TW) also reached the daily limit.

In the high-end electronics sector, Chalux (2059-TW) surged to the daily limit, setting a new record price, and closed with a gain of 7%, while New Era (7750-TW) gained 6%, but Jenstrat (3653-TW) fell by over 5%, while Kinch (8210-TW) and Zhongbang (2345-TW) fell by 2-3%, and Kinch (2368-TW) fell by 5.7%.

Looking at the non-electronics sector, Hsinchu Science Park-based Hsinchu Science Park (1605-TW) performed strongly, with a closing price that reached the daily limit, while AOP (6446-TW) gained 7% despite the negative impact of the arbitration case with international pharmaceutical companies, but China Airlines (2610-TW) suffered a significant decline of 9% due to the decline in its second-quarter profit, which was affected by the surge in international oil prices, while Evergreen Marine Corp. (2618-TW) also fell by nearly 4%.

items.title: 全台最大能源展10/14登場 匯聚最新能源技術及綠色產業趨勢
items.title_en: Taiwan's Largest Energy Expo to Debut on Oct 14, Gathering Latest Energy Tech and Green Industry Trends
paras: 由貿協與 SEMI 旗下 GESA 綠能暨永續發展聯盟共同舉辦的「台灣國際淨零永續展」與「台灣國際智慧能源周」，將於今 (2026) 年 10 月 14 日 - 16 日在南港展覽館舉行。貿協表示，作為全台最具規模的再生能源與淨零專業展會，展覽將匯聚最新能源技術、減碳解方及產業趨勢，打造企業掌握市場脈動、拓展合作夥伴及開發國際商機的重要平台，即日起開放線上預先登記參觀。
據科學基礎目標倡議 (SBTi) 於 2026 年 4 月發布的最新趨勢報告指出，越來越多企業將減碳納入營運決策與長期發展藍圖，為因應產業對淨零解決方案的強勁需求，2026 年「台灣國際淨零永續展」匯聚眾多指標大廠，展出涵蓋 CBAM 因應策略、深度節能、碳管理與應用、綠電交易、綠色金融、循環經濟、檢驗認證等企業轉型所需的關鍵技術與服務，打造一站式淨零解決方案交流平台。
隨著 AI 應用快速發展及數位化進程持續推進，全球電力需求持續攀升，能源轉型已成為各國提升供電韌性與產業競爭力的重要課題，「台灣國際智慧能源周」今年將以「太陽光電」、「風力能源」、「智慧儲能應用」及「多元創能」四大展區，展出內容涵蓋零組件、設備材料、檢測驗證、系統整合、運維管理及人才培育等面向，「多元創能」展區，更廣邀氫能、地熱、小水力、海洋能及生質能等新興能源技術，掌握未來綠色能源市場商機。
貿協指出，今年同步規劃多場重量級主題論壇，涵蓋淨零行動、AI 驅動能源轉型、生物多樣性及企業永續治理等熱門議題，邀請產業領袖與專家分享最新趨勢與實務經驗，打造兼具前瞻視野與交流合作的重要場域。
其中，「淨零未來實戰論壇」將呼應本屆展會主軸 「Net-Zero in Action」，聚焦「國際金融永續」、「供應鏈標準升級」、「AI 算力」、「能源重組」及「碳數據治理」五大關鍵議題，協助企業掌握趨勢脈動，從策略布局到行動落地，進一步強化企業韌性與市場競爭力。
此外，展會亦將舉辦「永續獎」及採購洽談會等系列活動，透過永續創新成果展示與現場票選機制，提升大眾對永續議題的關注與參與。同時藉由採購洽談會串聯國內外買主與供應商，促進跨域合作與商機媒合，協助企業拓展市場版圖，貿協歡迎各界業者踴躍登記參觀，更多展覽訊息至官網查詢。
paras_en: The 'Taiwan International Net-Zero Sustainable Expo' and 'Taiwan International Smart Energy Week' will be held on October 14-16, 2026, at the Nangang Exhibition Hall. The Taiwan External Trade Development Council (TAITRA) stated that as the largest renewable energy and net-zero professional exhibition in Taiwan, the exhibition will gather the latest energy technologies, carbon reduction solutions, and industry trends, creating an important platform for businesses to grasp market dynamics, expand cooperation partners, and develop international business opportunities. Online pre-registration for visitors is now open.

According to the Science-Based Targets Initiative (SBTi) released in April 2026, more and more companies are incorporating carbon reduction into their operational decisions and long-term development plans. To meet the strong demand for net-zero solutions from industries, the 2026 'Taiwan International Net-Zero Sustainable Expo' will gather numerous flagship companies, showcasing key technologies and services required for corporate transformation, including CBAM response strategies, deep energy-saving, carbon management and application, green electricity trading, green finance, circular economy, and inspection and certification. This will create a one-stop net-zero solution exchange platform.

As AI applications rapidly develop and digitalization continues to advance, global power demand continues to rise, and energy transformation has become an important issue for countries to enhance power resilience and industry competitiveness. The 'Taiwan International Smart Energy Week' this year will focus on four major exhibition areas: 'Solar Photovoltaics', 'Wind Power', 'Smart Energy Storage Applications', and 'Diversified Creative Energy'. The exhibition content will cover components, equipment materials, testing and verification, system integration, maintenance management, and talent cultivation. The 'Diversified Creative Energy' area will also invite hydrogen, geothermal, small hydro, ocean, and biomass energy technologies, grasping future green energy market opportunities.

TAITRA pointed out that this year, multiple heavyweight theme forums will be planned simultaneously, covering net-zero actions, AI-driven energy transformation, biodiversity, and corporate sustainable governance. Industry leaders and experts will be invited to share the latest trends and practical experiences, creating an important field that combines forward-looking vision and exchange and cooperation.

Among them, the 'Net-Zero in Action' forum will focus on five key issues: 'International Financial Sustainability', 'Supply Chain Standard Upgrade', 'AI Computing Power', 'Energy Reorganization', and 'Carbon Data Governance'. This will help businesses grasp trend dynamics, from strategic layout to action implementation, further enhancing corporate resilience and market competitiveness.

In addition, the exhibition will also hold the 'Sustainable Awards' and procurement negotiation meetings, etc. Through the display of sustainable innovation achievements and on-site voting mechanisms, the public's attention and participation in sustainable issues will be enhanced. At the same time, through procurement negotiation meetings, domestic and foreign buyers and suppliers will be connected, promoting cross-domain cooperation and business matching, and helping businesses expand their market scope. TAITRA welcomes all industries to actively register for visits, and more exhibition information can be found on the official website.

items.title: 台積電7月營收4676億元 年增44%續創單月新高
items.title_en: TSMC July Revenue Reaches NT$467.58 Billion, Up 44.7% YoY
paras: 台積電 (2330-TW)(TSM-US) 今 (10) 日公布 7 月營收，達新台幣 4,675.8 億元，月增 5.6%，年增 44.7%，累計前 7 月營收為新台幣 2 兆 8,720.64 億元，年增 37%；受惠 AI 需求強勁，加上進入蘋果手機備貨期，台積電 7 月營收創下單月新高。
台積電預估，第三季營收 446-458 億美元，以中位數推算，季增 12%，年增 37%，以美元兌新台幣 32 為基礎計算，折合新台幣營收達 1 兆 4,272 億元至 1 兆 4,656 億元，以本月營收推算，8、9 月有機會續創新高。
台積電今日傳出，將與影像感測器龍頭索尼 (Sony) 共砸 1 兆日元，於 2029 年在日本量產次世代影像感測器，負責生產的公司為雙方合資公司，其由索尼出資 60%、台積電出資約 40%，搶佔 AI 視覺、機器人等相關市場。
台積電目前先進製程與先進封裝產能全面滿載，為因應客戶訂單，日前將今年資本支出金額上調至 600 億至 640 億美元，較先前為 520 億至 560 億美元大幅提升，並預計未來數年將維持較高的資本支出金額，被外界看好台積電龍頭地位仍難以撼動，將開啟數年的高速成長趨勢。
paras_en: TSMC (2330-TW)(TSM-US) announced its July revenue today, reaching NT$467.58 billion, up 5.6% MoM and 44.7% YoY. The company's cumulative revenue for the first seven months of the year reached NT$2.872 trillion, up 37% YoY. TSMC's revenue reached a new high in July, driven by strong demand for AI and the company's entry into Apple's iPhone supply chain.

TSMC estimates its third-quarter revenue to be between $44.6 billion and $45.8 billion, with a midpoint of $45.2 billion, representing a 12% increase from the previous quarter and a 37% increase from the same period last year. Based on an exchange rate of NT$32 per USD, the company's revenue is expected to reach NT$1.427 trillion to NT$1.4656 trillion. If the company's current revenue trend continues, it may reach new highs in August and September.

TSMC has announced plans to invest NT$1 trillion with Sony (Sony) to produce next-generation image sensors in Japan in 2029. The joint venture will be responsible for producing the image sensors, with Sony holding a 60% stake and TSMC holding a 40% stake. The partnership aims to capture a larger share of the AI vision and robotics markets.

TSMC's advanced process and packaging capacity are fully loaded, and the company has increased its capital expenditure for the year to $60 billion to $64 billion, up from the previous estimate of $52 billion to $56 billion. The company expects to maintain a high level of capital expenditure in the coming years, solidifying its position as a leader in the industry and paving the way for a period of rapid growth.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉AAOI業績亮眼 激勵矽光族群抱團亮燈漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: AAOI's Earnings Shine, Inspiring Silicon Photonics Sector to Rise
paras: 美股光通訊大廠 AAOI(AAOI-US) 上周五公布第 2 季財報，營收年增 86% 創歷史新高，並成功轉虧為盈，也帶動台廠光通訊族群今 (10) 日持續上攻，聯亞 (3081-TW)、華星光 (4979-TW)、聯鈞 (3450-TW)、光環 (3234-TW)、光聖 (3450-TW)、上詮 (3363-TW) 等多檔衝漲停，波若威 (3163-TW)、眾達 - KY(4977-TW)、統新 (6426-TW) 也大漲逾 7-9%
法人指出，AAOI 的超乎預期表現，對同樣深度佈局 AI 數據中心光互聯的 Lumentum(LITE-US) 和 Coherent(COHR-US) 構成利多，因 AI 資料中心持續擴張，對整個光通訊產業釋放正面訊號。
據 AAOI 公告營收，除了資料中心業務營收首度突破 1 億美元，在個別產品方面，800G 營收年增亮眼，營收較去 (2025) 年飆增逾 10 倍，也激勵同族群 Coherent(COHR-US) 與 Lumentum(LITE-US) 股價上周五飆漲 13.44％及 6％。
台廠矽光族群中，目前已先公告的幾家廠商， 7 月營收也繳出年月雙增的亮眼表現，推升近期股價上揚，包括聯鈞 7 月營收 12.2 億元、月增 7%、年增 98%；聯亞 7 月營收 5.01 億元，月增 19.2%、年增 177%；華星光 7 月營收為 5.01 億元，月增 11.8%、年增 31.01%；光環 7 月營收 9,604 萬元、月增 25.2％、年增 96.94%。
paras_en: US-based optical communication giant AAOI (AAOI-US) released its Q2 financial report last Friday, with revenue increasing by 86% year-over-year to a historic high, and successfully turning losses into profits. This also drove Taiwanese optical communication stocks, including Union (3081-TW), Hiwafer (4979-TW), Uniflex (3450-TW), Gigalight (3234-TW), Gigastone (3450-TW), and Upmost (3363-TW), to surge and hit their daily limits. Other stocks, such as Prowell (3163-TW), ZyXEL - KY (4977-TW), and Unitech (6426-TW), also rose by more than 7-9%.

Institutional investors pointed out that AAOI's better-than-expected performance is a positive factor for Lumentum (LITE-US) and Coherent (COHR-US), which have also deeply invested in AI data center optical interconnection. As AI data centers continue to expand, the entire optical communication industry is releasing positive signals.

According to AAOI's announcement, its revenue has broken through $100 million for the first time in the data center business. In terms of individual products, 800G revenue has increased significantly, with a year-over-year increase of more than 10 times compared to 2025. This has also inspired Coherent (COHR-US) and Lumentum (LITE-US) stocks to rise by 13.44% and 6% respectively last Friday.

Among Taiwanese silicon photonics companies, several companies that have announced their July revenue have also reported impressive year-over-year and month-over-month growth, driving up their stock prices. items.title: 黃仁勳罕見開口挺AI開源！一封公開信炸出矽谷「開源vs閉源」兩大陣營博弈
items.title_en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang Rarely Speaks Out in Support of AI Open-Source, Sparking a Valley-Wide Debate on Open-Source vs Closed-Source
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳罕見聲援「開放權重」AI 模型，短短數天便吸引 70 多家企業與 AI 業界人士聯署，讓開放與封閉模型兩大陣營正式浮上檯面。這場看似技術路線之爭，背後其實牽動晶片、雲端、模型與 AI 應用的利益重新分配。
一向低調、鮮少在社群媒體上表態的黃仁勳，日前罕見地在 X 上發出他個人的第一則貼文，內容直接聲援一封題為《開放權重與美國 AI 領導力》（Open Weights and American AI Leadership）的聯署公開信。
這封信在短短數天內，聯署企業數量便從最初的 25 家暴增至 70 餘家，累積閱讀量突破 6000 萬次，也讓外界首次清楚看見，矽谷 AI 產業在「開放模型」與「封閉模型」兩條路線上，已形成壁壘分明的兩大陣營。
這封公開信的訴求相當直接：呼籲業界共同支持「開放權重」模型的發展，並反對監管單位對開源 AI 模型採取一刀切式的限制。
分析指出，這表面上看似只是一次產業倡議，但實際上內容直指幾個關鍵議題，包括防止新創企業被單一模型供應商綁定、將競爭從模型層擴大到雲端與晶片層、主張技術透明度有助於安全治理，以及為「知識蒸餾」（利用大型模型的輸出訓練較小模型）技術辯護，強調這是研究上行之有年的正當做法，不應被視為侵權或竊取。
信中傳達的核心立場，可以歸納為一句話：監管機構不應該為了防範尚未發生的風險，而限制開放權重這條技術路線的發展空間。
微軟 (MSFT-US) 執行長納德拉（Satya Nadella）、特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 執行長馬斯克、圖靈獎得主楊立昆（Yann LeCun），以及 AI 學者吳恩達（Andrew Ng）等重量級人物皆列名聲援，陣容堪稱近年 AI 圈規模最大的一次集體表態。

各懷盤算：誰在支持開源，為了什麼

觀察這份聯署名單背後的企業組成，不難發現這其實是一場關於 AI 產業鏈利潤分配的角力，各方支持開源都有各自的商業考量。
晶片與硬體廠商如輝達、戴爾科技 (DELL-US) ，最在意的是算力需求能否持續擴張。當愈來愈多企業選擇自行部署與微調開放權重模型，硬體採購與雲端算力的需求也會隨之水漲船高，這正是輝達力挺開源的根本動機。
微軟、Palantir(PLTR-US) 等雲端服務與企業軟體業者，則希望藉由開放權重模型豐富自家雲端平台的產品線，讓企業客戶不必被單一 API 供應商綁定，進而把客戶留在自己的雲端與訂閱服務生態中。
以 Meta(META-US) 為首的開源陣營與生態基礎設施業者，則是希望透過開放模型（如 Llama 系列）掌握技術標準的主導權；Mistral、Hugging Face 等新創公司也藉此爭取原本被閉源巨頭壟斷的企業客戶。
而創投圈如 a16z、YC 等機構，則擔心若底層模型長期被少數閉源公司把持，應用層新創的獲利空間將被大幅壓縮，因此力挺開放權重，以確保新創公司在成本與商業模式上仍有議價空間。

Anthropic 缺席聯署 立場鮮明成為焦點

值得注意的是，在這波近乎「集體站隊」的聲勢中，Anthropic 的缺席格外顯眼。
作為閉源陣營的代表性企業，Anthropic 不僅未加入聯署，其員工 Julian 更在 X 上公開對開源陣營表達不以為然的態度，直接引發吳恩達的回應。
吳恩達表示，任何公司都有權利選擇不公開自己的程式碼，但沒有立場去阻止其他人選擇開源。
外界普遍認為，Anthropic 對開放權重的保留態度，與其商業模式高度相關。
該公司的營收與估值，很大程度建立在模型能力的稀缺性之上。一旦市場上出現足以替代的開源模型，其 API 訂價的溢價空間與資本市場對其成長性的想像，都可能受到衝擊。而監管政策未來如何拿捏，也仍是開源陣營必須持續面對的變數。

模型走向「基礎設施化」，應用層成新戰場

分析稱，隨著開源模型的性能持續逼近甚至部分超越閉源模型，業界觀察普遍認為，底層大型語言模型正逐漸「基礎設施化」，也就是逐漸成為低成本、高普及的公共資源，單靠堆疊參數規模已難以構成長期競爭優勢。
在這樣的趨勢下，產業利潤可能會朝兩端集中：一端是輝達等掌握運算基礎設施的硬體廠商；另一端則是能將 AI 技術與企業真實資料、業務流程及智慧代理（Agent）深度結合的應用層公司。
與此同時，企業客戶對資料主權與技術安全性的重視程度提高，也讓「參數規模較小、可私有化部署、性能貼近實際需求」的垂直領域模型，加上端側運算裝置（如 AI PC、AI 手機）的普及，被部分業界人士視為下一階段較具確定性的商業化方向。
這場開放與封閉路線之爭，短期內恐怕難有定論。但對整個 AI 產業而言，這場公開的路線辯論，某種程度上也標誌著這個產業正式告別野蠻生長的早期階段，進入規則與利益重新分配的新局面。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang has rarely spoken out in support of open-source AI models, but his recent endorsement has sparked a valley-wide debate on open-source vs closed-source.
Huang, who is usually low-key and rarely speaks out on social media, recently posted a rare message on X in support of an open letter titled 'Open Weights and American AI Leadership'.

The open letter, which has gained over 60 million reads in a short span of time, has seen the number of signatories jump from 25 to over 70, making it clear that the AI industry in Silicon Valley has formed two distinct camps: open-source and closed-source.

The open letter's demands are straightforward: it calls on the industry to support the development of open-source models and opposes regulatory bodies from imposing blanket restrictions on open-source AI models.

Analysts point out that this seemingly technical debate actually touches on several key issues, including preventing startups from being locked into a single model provider, expanding competition from the model layer to the cloud and chip layers, advocating for transparency in technology to improve governance, and defending the use of 'knowledge distillation' (training smaller models using the output of large models) as a legitimate research practice.
The core stance of the open letter can be summed up in one sentence: regulatory bodies should not restrict the development of open-source models to prevent potential risks that have not yet occurred.

Microsoft (MSFT-US) CEO Satya Nadella, Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk, Turing Award winner Yann LeCun, and AI expert Andrew Ng, among others, have signed the open letter, making it one of the largest collective statements in the AI community in recent years.
The signatories' motivations are varied, with each having their own commercial considerations.
Chip and hardware manufacturers like NVIDIA and Dell (DELL-US) are concerned about whether the demand for computing power will continue to grow.

Microsoft, Palantir (PLTR-US), and other cloud service and enterprise software providers hope to enrich their cloud platforms with open-source models, allowing customers to avoid being locked into a single API provider and keeping customers within their cloud and subscription services ecosystem.

The open-source camp, led by Meta (META-US), hopes to control the standards of technology through open models (such as the Llama series); startups like Mistral and Hugging Face also seek to win over customers from closed-source giants.

Venture capital firms like a16z and YC are concerned that if the underlying models are controlled by a few closed-source companies, the profit space for application-layer startups will be significantly compressed, so they support open-source to ensure that startups have room for negotiation on costs and business models.
Anthropic's absence from the open letter has become a focal point, with its employees expressing skepticism about the open-source camp.
Andrew Ng responded that any company has the right to choose not to open-source its code, but it has no right to prevent others from doing so.
The external community believes that Anthropic's cautious attitude towards open-source is closely related to its business model, which relies heavily on the scarcity of model capabilities.

Anthropic's revenue and valuation are largely based on the scarcity of model capabilities. If open-source models appear in the market, the API pricing premium and the capital market's imagination of its growth potential may be affected.
The regulatory policy in the future will also be a variable that the open-source camp must continue to face.

As open-source models continue to approach and even surpass closed-source models in performance, the industry has come to a consensus that large language models are gradually 'infrastructure-izing', becoming low-cost and widely available public resources, and relying solely on parameter scale is no longer a long-term competitive advantage.

In this trend, industry profits may concentrate at both ends: one end is held by chip manufacturers like NVIDIA, and the other end is held by companies that can deeply integrate AI technology with enterprise real data, business processes, and intelligent agents.

At the same time, the importance of data sovereignty and technical security for enterprise customers has increased, making vertical domain models with smaller parameters, private deployment, and performance close to actual needs, as well as edge computing devices (such as AI PCs and AI phones), a more certain commercial direction in the next stage.

This open-source vs closed-source debate may not have a clear conclusion in the short term, but it marks the beginning of the AI industry's transition from a wild-growth early stage to a stage with rules and interest redistribution.

items.title: SpaceX為微軟補AI算力？2027年底拚10GW、年營收衝3000億美元
items.title_en: SpaceX to Supplement Microsoft's AI Computing Power? Aiming for 10GW by 2027 with $300 Billion in Annual Revenue
paras: 太空探索公司 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 正在悄然轉身，從火箭與衛星通訊業務跨足超大規模運算領域，而且擴張速度遠超市場預期，且微軟 (MSFT-US) 有望成為最大客戶。
研究機構 Semianalysis 近期發布報告指出，SpaceX 有機會在 2027 年底前新增超過 10GW 的運算容量，並帶動年度經常性收入（ARR）攀升至 3000 億美元的驚人規模。
這項野心並非空穴來風。馬斯克本人稍早在 SpaceX 首場業績說明會上便已表態，公司設定的「保守」目標是在 2027 年單一年度內完成 6 至 8GW 的新增算力建置與交付，樂觀情況下甚至可能突破 10GW 大關。
若以業界普遍估算的每 GW 約 500 億美元資本支出換算，SpaceX 明年的資本支出恐將落在 3000 億至 5000 億美元之間，這個數字已可與亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) AWS、Google(GOOGL-US) 等雲端龍頭的投資規模相提並論。
分析指出，對一家獲利能力遠不如主流雲端服務商的公司來說，這樣的手筆足以讓市場為之側目。
Semianalysis 表示，該機構已逐站評估 SpaceX 旗下所有適合開發的場址，並持續追蹤其燃氣發電設備的採購進度，認為前述目標具備相當高的執行可行性。
支撐這股擴張浪潮的核心邏輯，在於 AI 推論服務驚人的獲利空間。根據 Semianalysis 自行開發的 Tokenomics 模型與推理模擬器估算，OpenAI 與 Anthropic 在採用輝達 (NVDA-US) GB300 晶片叢集提供 API 推理服務時，每 GW 容量每年可創造超過 1000 億美元營收。
若以每 GPU 每小時 3 美元的保守租賃行情計算，每 GW 的年運營成本僅約 120 億美元，換算下來推理業務毛利率動輒超過 60%，部分主力模型甚至可達 85% 以上。
這套獲利模型同樣適用於微軟。報告指出，微軟已在 2026 年 4 月與 OpenAI 重新談判合作條款，取消了原先 20% 的營收拆分機制，代表微軟未來透過 OpenAI 模型提供推理服務時，能享有與 OpenAI、Anthropic 相近的每 MW 營收與利潤率，卻完全不必負擔模型訓練成本。
Semianalysis 將此形容為「百年一遇的機會」。

微軟自身鬧「算力荒」 SpaceX 趁勢補位

微軟一度在 2024 年底大幅收縮資料中心的租賃步伐，但 Semianalysis 指出，這個局面已在 2025 至 2026 年間出現徹底反轉。
去年 10 月，微軟與 OpenAI 簽下一紙估值高達 2500 億美元的基礎設施即服務協議，Semianalysis 估算此案牽涉約 7GW 算力，也讓微軟自家的 Foundry API 業務與 Copilot 等應用場景一度陷入產能瓶頸。
為填補缺口，微軟今年以來已透過租賃、自建與長期購電協議等多重管道，累計簽下超過 10GW 的算力承諾，總價值超過 3000 億美元。
在此背景下 Semianalysis 認為，微軟與 SpaceX 洽談一筆 3GW、總值約 1500 億美元合約的可能性「並非不可能」，理由有二個：

一是微軟本身正處於算力擴張高峰期，急需新增產能；
二是 SpaceX 比照其對 Anthropic、Google 的合約模式，提供 90 天可解約條款，大幅降低財務風險，也讓內部審批流程更容易過關。


Semianalysis 同時指出，微軟對 SpaceX 算力的潛在需求，將成爲推動 Azure 營收增速從約 42% 躍升至逾 100% 的關鍵變量。

顛覆建廠速度 「速度優先」打法震撼業界

Semianalysis 特別點出，SpaceX 真正的競爭優勢，在於徹底顛覆了傳統資料中心「效率優先」的建設邏輯，改採「速度優先」策略。
報告舉出多個實例：

SpaceX 旗下 Colossus 1 的 300MW 設施僅耗時 122 天便完工；
德州 Southaven 電廠從今年 2 月的 27 台燃氣渦輪機（約 495MW），短短五個月內擴張到 7 月的 69 台、總容量達 1.7GW；
代號「MiniHard」的新專案自 3 月動工後，預計約五個月就能達到 450 至 500MW 規模。


面對供應鏈瓶頸，SpaceX 也採取了多項非典型手段，包括改用中國製電力模組取代積壓逾兩年的大型變壓器、在二手市場搶購燃氣渦輪機（其中部分機組原本預定交付給甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 位於新墨西哥州的據點），並透過高度平行化的施工方式與預組裝壓縮測試週期。
相較同規模資料中心動輒需要更龐大的人力，Colossus 2 高峰期每日用工僅約 3000 人。
Semianalysis 認為，在算力極度稀缺、AI 推理利潤率居高不下的當下，一座能在三個月內交付、又附帶 90 天解約條款的 500MW 叢集，堪稱市場上數一數二稀缺的資產。
而 Google 最終選擇與 SpaceX 簽約，正是這套邏輯最有力的佐證。

資金從何而來？輝達供應商融資成關鍵

針對 SpaceX 是否具備支撐如此龐大資本支出財務實力的外界質疑，Semianalysis 則提出兩條可能路徑。
其一是輝達可能以供應商融資的形式，協助 SpaceX 降低前期現金壓力，被視為馬斯克在業績會上宣布未來將全面採用輝達晶片的重要原因之一，儘管 SpaceX 先前確實評估過 Google TPU 與 AMD 晶片等替代方案。
其二則是 SpaceX 憑藉業界最快的交付速度，以每 MW 每年 3000 萬至 5000 萬美元的溢價定價策略，讓資本支出得以在不到一年內透過營運現金流回收。
綜合上述因素，Semianalysis 推算，即便 SpaceX 2027 年新增的算力中僅有一半投入商業推理變現，其餘留給旗下 Grok 與 Cursor 團隊用於模型訓練，SpaceX 的年度經常性收入仍有望在 2027 年底衝上 3000 億美元大關。
paras_en: SpaceX, a space exploration company, is quietly transforming itself from a rocket and satellite communications business to a large-scale computing domain, with an expansion speed that far exceeds market expectations. Microsoft is expected to become its largest customer.

According to a recent report by research institution Semianalysis, SpaceX has the opportunity to add more than 10GW of computing capacity by the end of 2027, driving its annual recurring revenue (ARR) to a staggering $300 billion.

This ambition is not unfounded. Musk himself has stated that the company's 'conservative' goal is to complete 6-8GW of new algorithmic construction and delivery in 2027, with the possibility of exceeding 10GW.

If calculated based on the industry's common estimate of $5 billion in capital expenditure per GW, SpaceX's capital expenditure next year may fall between $30 billion and $50 billion, a number that can be compared to the investment scale of Amazon's AWS and Google Cloud.
Analysts point out that for a company with far lower profitability than mainstream cloud service providers, this investment is enough to make the market take notice.

Semianalysis states that the institution has evaluated all developable sites under SpaceX and has been tracking the progress of its gas-powered generation equipment procurement, believing that the aforementioned goal has a high degree of feasibility.

The core logic supporting this expansion wave lies in the huge profit space of AI inference services. According to Semianalysis's self-developed Tokenomics model and inference simulator, OpenAI and Anthropic can create over $10 billion in revenue per year per GW of capacity when using NVIDIA's GB300 chip cluster to provide API inference services.

If calculated based on a conservative rental price of $3 per GPU per hour, the annual operating cost per GW is approximately $1.2 billion, resulting in a gross margin of over 60% for the inference business, with some main models reaching over 85%.

This profit model also applies to Microsoft. The report points out that Microsoft renegotiated its cooperation terms with OpenAI in April 2026, canceling the original 20% revenue sharing mechanism, meaning Microsoft will enjoy similar revenue and profit margins to OpenAI and Anthropic when providing inference services through OpenAI models without bearing model training costs.
Semianalysis describes this as a 'once-in-a-century opportunity'.

Microsoft's 'computing power shortage' is being supplemented by SpaceX. Microsoft had significantly reduced its data center leasing pace at the end of 2024 but has since reversed this trend between 2025 and 2026.

In October last year, Microsoft signed a $25 billion infrastructure-as-a-service agreement with OpenAI, which Semianalysis estimates involves approximately 7GW of computing power, causing Microsoft's Foundry API business and Copilot applications to face production bottlenecks.

To fill the gap, Microsoft has signed contracts for over 10GW of computing power commitments this year, with a total value of over $30 billion, through multiple channels such as leasing, self-construction, and long-term power purchase agreements.

In this context, Semianalysis believes that the possibility of Microsoft discussing a 3GW, $15 billion contract with SpaceX is 'not impossible', for two reasons: Microsoft is in a period of rapid expansion and urgently needs new production capacity, and SpaceX offers a 90-day termination clause, significantly reducing financial risk.
Semianalysis also points out that Microsoft's potential demand for SpaceX's computing power will be a key variable driving Azure's revenue growth from approximately 42% to over 100%.
Subverting the traditional construction logic of data centers, SpaceX has adopted a 'speed-first' strategy, which has shaken the industry.

The report cites several examples, including the completion of SpaceX's Colossus 1 facility in just 122 days and the expansion of the Southaven power plant in Texas from 27 gas turbines in February to 69 in July, reaching a total capacity of 1.7GW.

To address supply chain bottlenecks, SpaceX has taken unconventional measures, including using Chinese-made power modules to replace large transformers that have been stockpiled for over two years and purchasing gas turbines on the second-hand market, some of which were originally intended for Oracle's New Mexico facility.
In comparison to similar-scale data centers, which require a much larger workforce, Colossus 2's peak daily labor force is approximately 3,000 people.

Semianalysis believes that in a time of extreme scarcity of computing power and high AI inference profit margins, a 500MW cluster that can be delivered in three months with a 90-day termination clause is a rare asset in the market.
Google's decision to sign a contract with SpaceX is strong evidence of this logic.
Regarding the question of whether SpaceX has the financial strength to support such large capital expenditures, Semianalysis proposes two possible paths.

One is that NVIDIA may provide supplier financing to help SpaceX reduce its upfront cash pressure, which is seen as one of the reasons why Musk announced that SpaceX will fully adopt NVIDIA chips in the future, despite having previously evaluated alternative solutions such as Google TPU and AMD chips.

The other is that SpaceX, with the fastest delivery speed in the industry, can recover its capital expenditures through operating cash flow in less than a year by adopting a pricing strategy with a premium of $30-50 million per MW per year.

Combining these factors, Semianalysis estimates that even if only half of SpaceX's new computing power in 2027 is used for commercial inference, with the rest reserved for model training by its Grok and Cursor teams, SpaceX's annual recurring revenue can still be expected to exceed $30 billion by the end of 2027.

items.title: 台積電7月營收4676億元 年增44%續創單月新高
items.title_en: TSMC July Revenue Reaches NT$467.58 Billion, Up 44.7% YoY
paras: 台積電 (2330-TW)(TSM-US) 今 (10) 日公布 7 月營收，達新台幣 4,675.8 億元，月增 5.6%，年增 44.7%，累計前 7 月營收為新台幣 2 兆 8,720.64 億元，年增 37%；受惠 AI 需求強勁，加上進入蘋果手機備貨期，台積電 7 月營收創下單月新高。
台積電預估，第三季營收 446-458 億美元，以中位數推算，季增 12%，年增 37%，以美元兌新台幣 32 為基礎計算，折合新台幣營收達 1 兆 4,272 億元至 1 兆 4,656 億元，以本月營收推算，8、9 月有機會續創新高。
台積電今日傳出，將與影像感測器龍頭索尼 (Sony) 共砸 1 兆日元，於 2029 年在日本量產次世代影像感測器，負責生產的公司為雙方合資公司，其由索尼出資 60%、台積電出資約 40%，搶佔 AI 視覺、機器人等相關市場。
台積電目前先進製程與先進封裝產能全面滿載，為因應客戶訂單，日前將今年資本支出金額上調至 600 億至 640 億美元，較先前為 520 億至 560 億美元大幅提升，並預計未來數年將維持較高的資本支出金額，被外界看好台積電龍頭地位仍難以撼動，將開啟數年的高速成長趨勢。
paras_en: TSMC (2330-TW)(TSM-US) announced its July revenue today, reaching NT$467.58 billion, up 5.6% MoM and 44.7% YoY. The company's cumulative revenue for the first seven months of the year reached NT$2.872 trillion, up 37% YoY. TSMC's revenue reached a new high in July, driven by strong demand for AI and the company's entry into Apple's iPhone supply chain.

TSMC estimates its third-quarter revenue to be between $44.6 billion and $45.8 billion, with a midpoint of $45.2 billion, representing a 12% increase from the previous quarter and a 37% increase from the same period last year. Based on an exchange rate of NT$32 per USD, the company's revenue is expected to reach NT$1.427 trillion to NT$1.4656 trillion. If the company's current revenue trend continues, it may reach new highs in August and September.

TSMC has announced plans to invest NT$1 trillion with Sony (Sony) to produce next-generation image sensors in Japan in 2029. The joint venture will be responsible for producing the image sensors, with Sony holding a 60% stake and TSMC holding a 40% stake. The partnership aims to capture a larger share of the AI vision and robotics markets.

TSMC's advanced process and packaging capacity are fully loaded, and the company has increased its capital expenditure for the year to $60 billion to $64 billion, up from the previous estimate of $52 billion to $56 billion. The company expects to maintain a high level of capital expenditure in the coming years, solidifying its position as a leader in the industry and paving the way for a period of rapid growth.

items.title: iPhone Ultra配色曝光！首款摺疊iPhone傳有「兩顏色」、相機設計也外洩
items.title_en: iPhone Ultra Color Options Leaked: Foldable iPhone to Come in Two Colors, Camera Design Also Revealed
paras: 最新曝光的「iPhone Ultra」鏡頭保護配件圖片顯示，蘋果首款可摺疊 iPhone 可能將推出銀色與深藍色兩種配色。
根據《MacRumors》報導，爆料者 Sonny Dickson 近日分享了兩款第三方鏡頭保護蓋的圖片，這些配件專為套在「iPhone Ultra」的相機凸起模組上而設計，其中一款採用銀色，另一款則為深藍色。
Dickson 過去曾多次準確曝光蘋果產品的配件與模型機，包括他日前提前曝光的 iPhone 18 Pro 系列配色。
這些圖片亦進一步印證了今年 5 月的一項報導。
該報導援引《Macworld》供應鏈消息人士的說法指出，蘋果將推出經典的銀色與白色版本，另有一款類似 iPhone 17 Pro「深藍色」的靛藍色選項。
6 月時，另有消息將銀色列為首個獲得「確認」的配色，而同一週的另一項報導則稱，較深色的版本可能不會採用黑色。
而 Dickson 曝光的這些配件，則提供了目前為止最清晰的視覺證據，進一步確認銀色與深藍色兩種配色。
這種較為低調的配色策略與 iPhone 18 Pro 形成鮮明對比。據傳 iPhone 18 Pro 今年除了銀色外，還將新增深櫻桃紅（Dark Cherry）與淺藍色兩種配色。此前也曾有傳聞稱 Pro 系列將推出黑色版本，不過後續消息指出，蘋果最終決定今年不推出黑色款。
曝光的配件也清楚呈現了外界先前廣泛傳聞的可摺疊 iPhone 背面相機平台設計。從圖片來看，後置相機將配備兩枚水平排列的鏡頭，旁邊則設有膠囊形閃光燈與 LiDAR 光學雷達掃描器。
預計這款可摺疊的「iPhone Ultra」將與 iPhone 18 Pro 及 iPhone 18 Pro Max 一同於下個月正式發表。
paras_en: Newly leaked images of the "iPhone Ultra" camera protection accessories show that Apple's first foldable iPhone may come in silver and deep blue colors.

According to a report by MacRumors, leaker Sonny Dickson recently shared two images of third-party camera protection covers designed for the camera bump module of the "iPhone Ultra", one in silver and the other in deep blue.
Dickson has a history of accurately leaking Apple product accessories and model machines, including his recent leak of the iPhone 18 Pro series color options.
These images also further confirm a report from May this year.
The report, citing a supply chain source from Macworld, states that Apple will release classic silver and white versions, as well as a deep blue option similar to the iPhone 17 Pro.
In June, another report stated that silver would be the first color to be "confirmed", while another report from the same week suggested that the deeper color option may not be black.
Dickson's leak provides the clearest visual evidence to date, further confirming the silver and deep blue color options.

This more subdued color strategy contrasts with the iPhone 18 Pro, which is expected to come in silver, deep cherry, and light blue colors, in addition to a previously rumored black option that was later ruled out.

The leaked accessories also clearly show the camera platform design that has been widely rumored for the foldable iPhone's back. The rear camera will feature two horizontally arranged lenses, accompanied by a capsule-shaped flash and LiDAR optical radar scanner.
The foldable "iPhone Ultra" is expected to be released alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max next month.

items.title: 高薪僅入場券！矽谷搶人才大有多瘋？幫你開Slack、每天開會想怎麼追你、送上客製化禮物
items.title_en: High Pay, Only a Ticket to Enter: Is the Talent War in Silicon Valley Going Crazy?
paras: 美國財經媒體《商業內幕 (BI)》最新報導指出，薪水在 AI 人才爭奪戰中早已不是決勝關鍵，而是「誠意」與「懂你」的極致比拚，最新案例來自近期被 SpaceX 收購、估值高達 600 億美元的明星程式設計工具商 Cursor。
為了搶下一位頂尖工程師，Cursor 團隊甚至飛越半個地球、送上「土耳其吉他」，只為讓候選人感受到「非你不可」的獨特重視。
Cursor 人才招聘負責人 Matt Ward 在播客《People by WTF》中坦言，招募頂尖人才就像追求「根本高攀不起的人」。Cursor 會為每位重點對象開設專屬 Slack 頻道，協調晚餐、會面與各種「追求」細節，甚至每天開會討論如何說服對方。
Ward 曾得知一名備受追捧的候選人畢業於表演藝術高中、擅長古典小提琴，便專程在紐約找到一家特色樂器店，為其訂製一件罕見的弦樂器。
他說：「東西不貴，但那份用心、細節與獨特性才是重點。」
這種近乎「偏執」的招聘文化，源自執行長 Michael Truell 早期的堅持。為了招攬最初 10 名員工，Cursor 團隊曾採取「瘋狂手段」。在被拒絕後，直接飛往候選人所在的另一個大洲當面溝通。
如今，Cursor 規模擴大，流程更系統化，但核心邏輯不變。與其廣泛撒網，不如精準鎖定全球僅有的 50 位頂尖人選，並展開持久攻勢。
報導指出，這一現象折射出 AI 熱潮下人才市場的新現實。頂尖人才同時手握多家巨頭的百萬年薪、頂級股權與前沿項目邀約，最終決定去向的，往往是文化認同與被理解的感受。這場戰爭已改寫矽谷招聘規則，Meta 執行長祖克柏曾親自致信目標研究員，甚至送湯慰問；OpenAI 隨後也在招聘流程中加入「送湯」環節，足見高層親自下場已成常態。
當然，錢依然重要。谷歌前人力資源負責人 Laszlo Bock 指出，若能招攬到真正頂尖的 AI 研究者，即便花費 1 億美元對巨頭而言仍是「划算買賣」，因其創造的價值與阻斷競爭對手的戰略意義遠超成本。
Ward 還形容這些人才的待遇已超越 NBA 球星等級，但當薪資天花板被集體抬升後，真正的勝負關鍵早就從「價碼」轉向「靈魂共振」。
paras_en: A recent report by Business Insider (BI) reveals that salaries are no longer the decisive factor in the AI talent war, but rather a 'gesture' and 'understanding' to the extreme. A recent case comes from Cursor, a star programming tool company acquired by SpaceX for $60 billion.
To recruit the next top engineer, the Cursor team even flew halfway around the world to send a 'Turkish guitar' to the candidate, just to make them feel 'irreplaceable'.

Matt Ward, head of talent recruitment at Cursor, admitted in a podcast that recruiting top talent is like pursuing 'someone who is fundamentally unattainable'. Cursor sets up a dedicated Slack channel for each key target, coordinating dinner, meetings, and other 'pursuit' details, and even discusses how to convince them every day.

Ward learned that a highly sought-after candidate graduated from a performing arts high school and was skilled in classical violin, so he personally found a specialty instrument store in New York to commission a rare stringed instrument.
He said, 'It's not about the price, but about the thought, details, and uniqueness.'

This near-'obsessive' recruitment culture originated from the early insistence of CEO Michael Truell. To recruit the initial 10 employees, the Cursor team took 'crazy measures'. After being rejected, they flew directly to the candidate's location on another continent to communicate face-to-face.

Now, with Cursor's expanded scale and more systematic processes, the core logic remains unchanged. Instead of casting a wide net, they precisely target the global top 50 candidates and launch a sustained assault.

The report notes that this phenomenon reflects the new reality of the talent market under the AI craze. Top talent simultaneously holds million-dollar salaries, top-tier equity, and cutting-edge project invitations from multiple giants, and ultimately decides where to go based on cultural identity and feelings of being understood.

This war has rewritten the recruitment rules in Silicon Valley, with Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg personally sending a letter to target researchers and even sending soup to comfort them; OpenAI has also added a 'soup' segment to its recruitment process, showing that high-level executives are now commonly involved.

Of course, money still matters. Laszlo Bock, former head of human resources at Google, pointed out that even if it costs $1 billion to recruit a truly top AI researcher, it's still a 'worthwhile investment' for giants, as the value created and strategic significance of blocking competitors far exceed the cost.

items.title: 美股壞消息不斷卻「越漲越勇」！資金湧入半導體、高收益債與比特幣
paras: 半導體股重挫、公債殖利率居高不下、地緣政治風險未解，華爾街近來壞消息不斷，但資金流向說的卻是完全不同的故事。美股創新高之際，資金同步湧入高收益債與比特幣 ETF，推升美銀牛熊指標至 2021 年以來高點，市場情緒明顯升溫。
上週，標普 500 指數改寫歷史新高，那斯達克 100 指數繳出近兩個月最亮眼的單週表現；同一時間，高收益債券基金單週吸金達 40 億美元、創下近兩年新高，比特幣相關 ETF 五個交易日內也淨流入 5 億美元。
美銀「牛熊指標」隨之攀升至 2021 年以來的最高點，顯示市場情緒已明顯轉向樂觀。
這波樂觀情緒，正好發生在一場戲劇性事件之後。由有「矽谷股神」之稱的 Leopold Aschenbrenner 所創立的 AI 主題避險基金 Situational Awareness 爆倉，一度將費城半導體指數自六月高點拖低 29%。
然而市場並未如過往般選擇避險撤退，反倒把這場動盪當成進場訊號。短短兩個交易日內，每日 3 倍看多半導體 ETF(SOXL-US) 便湧入逾 20 億美元資金，隨後七個交易日累計漲幅超過 50%。
兩檔規模最大的非槓桿半導體 ETF 同期也合計吸金逾 70 億美元，各自上漲約 16%。整體而言，半導體相關槓桿與非槓桿基金上週合計吸引超過 110 億美元資金。
JonesTrading 首席市場策略師 Michael O"Rourke 將這股買氣形容為動能買盤掀起的「海嘯」，但他也提醒，不少資金依然集中在市值最大的幾檔科技股上，真正撐起指數漲勢的主力仍是七巨頭。

從股市到債市、加密貨幣，風險偏好全面回溫

分析人士指出，推升行情的不只是晶片股，而是跨資產類別的全面資金涌入。
根據美銀統計，高收益債券基金上週淨流入 40 億美元，創下兩年來單週新高；比特幣 ETF 儘管幣價已橫盤數月，五個交易日內仍吸金 5 億美元。
美銀牛熊指標因此升至 2021 年來高點，策略師 Michael Hartnett 團隊的分析指出，漲勢已從科技股核心板塊擴散開來，加上高收益債資金強勁、信用利差收窄，共同撐起了這股樂觀氛圍。
Natixis Investment Managers Solutions 投資組合策略師 Garrett Melson 則認為，眼下市場的疑慮被過度放大，風險資產基本面其實穩固。
他目前維持美股超配、聚焦大型科技股的部位，固定收益則相對低配。
Melson 強調，整體經濟表現依然良好，情緒與部位有時會過度延伸，但這種過熱只是局部現象, 類股輪動反而有助於消化泡沫、同時支撐大盤。

殖利率仍居高不下，成為最大隱憂

不過這場多頭盛宴並非毫無陰影。30 年期美債殖利率雖然近五個交易日有四天回落，但仍徘徊在近二十年高點附近，成為市場揮之不去的壓力來源。
至於殖利率為何居高不下，市場看法分歧。
一派認為 7 月底的飆升，是因為聯準會（Fed）主席華許（Kevin Warsh）未能給出明確的利率指引，讓外界對其抗通膨決心產生疑慮；另一派則認為，這其實反映投資人對經濟持續擴張的信心。
上週五公布的美國 7 月就業數據意外轉弱，加上前兩月數據下修，反而提振了股市、壓低了殖利率，市場因此押注聯準會短期內不至於被迫升息。
高盛資產管理的 Lindsay Rosner 指出，隨著數據逐漸明朗、油價趨穩，經濟全貌以及資本支出的回報率也變得更清晰，整體經濟依然強勁，市場正在消化 AI 相關的供給變化。
Wealth Enhancement 資深投資策略師 Ayako Yoshioka 則提醒，半導體雖仍是 AI 基礎建設的核心，但接下來的瓶頸恐怕會轉移到電力供應不足，而殖利率走高本身，仍是必須留意的風險。

每次回調都被視為買點，多頭信心愈戰愈強

分析指出，支撐這波風險偏好的，還有一種在市場上一再被驗證的心理慣性，即每次拉回都很短暫，每次恐慌都是進場機會。
Manulife Investment Management 資深投資組合經理 Nathan Thooft 觀察到，價格修正一再證明只是曇花一現，這種經驗不斷強化投資人的信心；反倒是在不確定性最高時選擇出場的人，往往錯過隨後最強勁的反彈。
Thooft 直言，現金雖然感覺安全，長期卻難以跑贏通膨與股市的獲利成長。他認為過去十年，那些一直等待更理想進場時機的投資人，大多已被市場拋在後頭。
市場情緒的快速修復，也反映在波動率指標上。芝加哥選擇權交易所（Cboe）半導體 ETF 波動率指數本週下滑近 9 個點，創下今年最大單週跌幅。儘管風險清單仍在拉長，但資金的實際流向，顯然仍指向風險資產。

items.title: iPhone 17要漲價了？傳蘋果最快8/10調高售價、記憶體成本飆升成關鍵
items.title_en: iPhone 17 May See Price Hike: Apple to Raise Prices as Early as August 10, Memory Costs Soar
paras: 根據最新傳聞，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 最快可能在本週一（10 日）調高 iPhone 17 售價，時間點甚至早於外界預期的下一波漲價，而更大規模的價格調整則預計將伴隨下月 iPhone 18 Pro 上市登場。
根據《MacRumors》報導，微博爆料帳號「Fixed Focus Digital」昨日發文表示，市場目前流傳 iPhone 17 將於 10 日起調整價格的消息。
不過，該爆料者並未明確表示價格是否真的會上調；相較之下，貼文較為確定地指出，蘋果已取消部分生產線將產能由原本增加 15% 至 30% 的計畫。
目前尚不清楚該貼文所指的產能調整，具體涉及哪些零組件或產品。
基於記憶體與儲存元件成本大幅上升，蘋果今年 6 月已調高 Mac、iPad 及多數其他產品的售價，但 iPhone、Apple Watch、AirPods、Studio Display 及配件則未受影響。
市場目前普遍傳言，蘋果下一波價格調整將以 iPhone 18 Pro 為主。
蘋果預計將於下月推出 iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max，以及首款折疊 iPhone；至於標準版 iPhone 18 與 iPhone 18e，則要等到 2027 年春季才會上市。
預計 iPhone 17 至少到明年仍將是蘋果的主流機型，可能成為蘋果在新一代產品上市前，單獨調整 iPhone 17 售價的充分理由。
若漲價成真，目前仍無法確定蘋果調高 iPhone 17 售價是否會涵蓋整個產品線，包括售價 599 美元的 iPhone 17e、799 美元的 iPhone 17、999 美元的 iPhone Air、1,099 美元的 iPhone 17 Pro，以及 1,199 美元的 iPhone 17 Pro Max，抑或僅有部分機型受到影響。
paras_en: According to the latest rumors, Apple (AAPL-US) may raise the price of iPhone 17 as early as August 10, beating the expected price hike cycle, and a more significant price adjustment is expected to accompany the release of iPhone 18 Pro next month.
A report by MacRumors cites a Weibo account called 'Fixed Focus Digital' stating that the market is circulating rumors that iPhone 17 will adjust its price starting from August 10.

However, the whistleblower did not explicitly confirm whether the price will indeed be raised; instead, the post is more certain that Apple has canceled plans to increase production capacity by 15% to 30%.
It is unclear which components or products are involved in the production adjustment mentioned in the post.

Given the significant increase in memory and storage component costs, Apple raised the prices of Mac, iPad, and most other products in June, but iPhone, Apple Watch, AirPods, Studio Display, and accessories were not affected.
The market is currently speculating that Apple's next price hike will focus on iPhone 18 Pro.
Apple plans to release iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and the first foldable iPhone next month, while the standard iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e will be released in the spring of 2027.

It is expected that iPhone 17 will remain Apple's mainstream model at least until next year and may be a sufficient reason for Apple to adjust the price of iPhone 17 before the release of new products.

If the price hike is confirmed, it is still unclear whether Apple will raise the prices of all iPhone models, including the iPhone 17e ($599), iPhone 17 ($799), iPhone Air ($999), iPhone 17 Pro ($1,099), and iPhone 17 Pro Max ($1,199), or only some models will be affected.

items.title: 首款都還未發！蘋果折疊iPhone三代路線圖先曝光 傳內外雙螢幕最快2028年放大
items.title_en: Apple's First Foldable iPhone Not Yet Released, But Third-Generation Roadmap Leaked
paras: 蘋果首款折疊 iPhone 尚未亮相，但三代產品路線圖已先行曝光，知名科技記者古爾曼近日在《Power On》通訊中披露，蘋果已著手規劃第三代折疊 iPhone，最快 2028 年推出，新機內外雙螢幕尺寸都將比前兩代進一步放大。
按目前節奏，初代折疊 iPhone 預計下月登場，第二代定檔 2027 年，第三代最快 2028 年跟進，這是業界首次出現「第三代」具體時程爆料。
古爾曼指出，初代折疊 iPhone 外螢幕約 5.5 吋、內螢幕約 7.8 吋，第三代若繼續放大，整機可視面積將再上一階，但具體數字古爾曼未透露。
初代硬體輪廓同步浮現：超薄機身、捨棄 Face ID 改回 Touch ID、搭載 A20 晶片與自研 C2 基帶，命名可能叫「iPhone Ultra」，要價 2000 美元起跳。
蘋果第二代「Ultra 2」項目已獲准開發，螢幕方案很大機率沿用初代，預計 2027 年秋季與 iPhone 問世 20 週年紀念機同台，第三代折疊 iPhone 則是真正把「大螢幕體驗」再推一層的版本。
業內人士解讀，蘋果顯然不把折疊 iPhone 當單發試水產品。初代折疊 iPhone 重點是把書本式折疊形態、幾乎無摺痕與高耐久鉸鏈落地；二代延續方案、陪跑 20 週年紀念機；三代靠螢幕放大拉開代差。
供應鏈指出，蘋果近期已上調 2026、2027 年折疊機出貨預期，初代量產 7 月下旬啟動，市場正盯著 9 月發表會驗證「Ultra」定價與形態能否重洗高階手機格局。
paras_en: Apple's first foldable iPhone has yet to be released, but the roadmap for its third generation has been leaked. Renowned tech journalist Gurman recently revealed in his Power On newsletter that Apple has already begun planning its third-generation foldable iPhone, which is expected to be released as early as 2028. The new device will feature larger inner and outer screens compared to its predecessors.

Based on the current pace, the first-generation foldable iPhone is expected to debut next month, followed by the second generation in 2027, and the third generation as early as 2028. This is the first time a specific timeline for the third generation has been leaked.

Gurman noted that the first-generation foldable iPhone has an outer screen of approximately 5.5 inches and an inner screen of around 7.8 inches. If the third generation continues to increase in size, the overall visible area of the device will increase further, although Gurman did not disclose specific numbers.

The hardware design of the first generation has also been revealed: a super-thin body, the abandonment of Face ID in favor of Touch ID, the use of the A20 chip and a custom C2 baseband, and a possible name of "iPhone Ultra" with a starting price of $2,000.

Apple's second-generation "Ultra 2" project has been approved for development, and it is likely that the screen scheme will be similar to the first generation. The device is expected to be released in the fall of 2027, coinciding with the 20th anniversary of the iPhone.

Industry insiders interpret this as Apple not treating the foldable iPhone as a single test product. The first-generation foldable iPhone focused on implementing a book-like folding design, almost no creases, and high durability hinges. The second generation continued the scheme, while the third generation will rely on larger screens to create a wider price gap.

The supply chain has indicated that Apple has recently increased its expectations for foldable iPhone shipments in 2026 and 2027. The first-generation production is expected to start in late July, and the market is watching the September launch event to see if the "Ultra" pricing and design can shake up the high-end smartphone market.

items.title: 黃仁勳罕見開口挺AI開源！一封公開信炸出矽谷「開源vs閉源」兩大陣營博弈
items.title_en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang Rarely Speaks Out in Support of AI Open-Source, Sparking a Valley-Wide Debate on Open-Source vs Closed-Source
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳罕見聲援「開放權重」AI 模型，短短數天便吸引 70 多家企業與 AI 業界人士聯署，讓開放與封閉模型兩大陣營正式浮上檯面。這場看似技術路線之爭，背後其實牽動晶片、雲端、模型與 AI 應用的利益重新分配。
一向低調、鮮少在社群媒體上表態的黃仁勳，日前罕見地在 X 上發出他個人的第一則貼文，內容直接聲援一封題為《開放權重與美國 AI 領導力》（Open Weights and American AI Leadership）的聯署公開信。
這封信在短短數天內，聯署企業數量便從最初的 25 家暴增至 70 餘家，累積閱讀量突破 6000 萬次，也讓外界首次清楚看見，矽谷 AI 產業在「開放模型」與「封閉模型」兩條路線上，已形成壁壘分明的兩大陣營。
這封公開信的訴求相當直接：呼籲業界共同支持「開放權重」模型的發展，並反對監管單位對開源 AI 模型採取一刀切式的限制。
分析指出，這表面上看似只是一次產業倡議，但實際上內容直指幾個關鍵議題，包括防止新創企業被單一模型供應商綁定、將競爭從模型層擴大到雲端與晶片層、主張技術透明度有助於安全治理，以及為「知識蒸餾」（利用大型模型的輸出訓練較小模型）技術辯護，強調這是研究上行之有年的正當做法，不應被視為侵權或竊取。
信中傳達的核心立場，可以歸納為一句話：監管機構不應該為了防範尚未發生的風險，而限制開放權重這條技術路線的發展空間。
微軟 (MSFT-US) 執行長納德拉（Satya Nadella）、特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 執行長馬斯克、圖靈獎得主楊立昆（Yann LeCun），以及 AI 學者吳恩達（Andrew Ng）等重量級人物皆列名聲援，陣容堪稱近年 AI 圈規模最大的一次集體表態。

各懷盤算：誰在支持開源，為了什麼

觀察這份聯署名單背後的企業組成，不難發現這其實是一場關於 AI 產業鏈利潤分配的角力，各方支持開源都有各自的商業考量。
晶片與硬體廠商如輝達、戴爾科技 (DELL-US) ，最在意的是算力需求能否持續擴張。當愈來愈多企業選擇自行部署與微調開放權重模型，硬體採購與雲端算力的需求也會隨之水漲船高，這正是輝達力挺開源的根本動機。
微軟、Palantir(PLTR-US) 等雲端服務與企業軟體業者，則希望藉由開放權重模型豐富自家雲端平台的產品線，讓企業客戶不必被單一 API 供應商綁定，進而把客戶留在自己的雲端與訂閱服務生態中。
以 Meta(META-US) 為首的開源陣營與生態基礎設施業者，則是希望透過開放模型（如 Llama 系列）掌握技術標準的主導權；Mistral、Hugging Face 等新創公司也藉此爭取原本被閉源巨頭壟斷的企業客戶。
而創投圈如 a16z、YC 等機構，則擔心若底層模型長期被少數閉源公司把持，應用層新創的獲利空間將被大幅壓縮，因此力挺開放權重，以確保新創公司在成本與商業模式上仍有議價空間。

Anthropic 缺席聯署 立場鮮明成為焦點

值得注意的是，在這波近乎「集體站隊」的聲勢中，Anthropic 的缺席格外顯眼。
作為閉源陣營的代表性企業，Anthropic 不僅未加入聯署，其員工 Julian 更在 X 上公開對開源陣營表達不以為然的態度，直接引發吳恩達的回應。
吳恩達表示，任何公司都有權利選擇不公開自己的程式碼，但沒有立場去阻止其他人選擇開源。
外界普遍認為，Anthropic 對開放權重的保留態度，與其商業模式高度相關。
該公司的營收與估值，很大程度建立在模型能力的稀缺性之上。一旦市場上出現足以替代的開源模型，其 API 訂價的溢價空間與資本市場對其成長性的想像，都可能受到衝擊。而監管政策未來如何拿捏，也仍是開源陣營必須持續面對的變數。

模型走向「基礎設施化」，應用層成新戰場

分析稱，隨著開源模型的性能持續逼近甚至部分超越閉源模型，業界觀察普遍認為，底層大型語言模型正逐漸「基礎設施化」，也就是逐漸成為低成本、高普及的公共資源，單靠堆疊參數規模已難以構成長期競爭優勢。
在這樣的趨勢下，產業利潤可能會朝兩端集中：一端是輝達等掌握運算基礎設施的硬體廠商；另一端則是能將 AI 技術與企業真實資料、業務流程及智慧代理（Agent）深度結合的應用層公司。
與此同時，企業客戶對資料主權與技術安全性的重視程度提高，也讓「參數規模較小、可私有化部署、性能貼近實際需求」的垂直領域模型，加上端側運算裝置（如 AI PC、AI 手機）的普及，被部分業界人士視為下一階段較具確定性的商業化方向。
這場開放與封閉路線之爭，短期內恐怕難有定論。但對整個 AI 產業而言，這場公開的路線辯論，某種程度上也標誌著這個產業正式告別野蠻生長的早期階段，進入規則與利益重新分配的新局面。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang has rarely spoken out in support of open-source AI models, but his recent endorsement has sparked a valley-wide debate on open-source vs closed-source.
Huang, who is usually low-key and rarely speaks out on social media, recently posted a rare message on X in support of an open letter titled 'Open Weights and American AI Leadership'.

The open letter, which has gained over 60 million reads in a short span of time, has seen the number of signatories jump from 25 to over 70, making it clear that the AI industry in Silicon Valley has formed two distinct camps: open-source and closed-source.

The open letter's demands are straightforward: it calls on the industry to support the development of open-source models and opposes regulatory bodies from imposing blanket restrictions on open-source AI models.

Analysts point out that this seemingly technical debate actually touches on several key issues, including preventing startups from being locked into a single model provider, expanding competition from the model layer to the cloud and chip layers, advocating for transparency in technology to improve governance, and defending the use of 'knowledge distillation' (training smaller models using the output of large models) as a legitimate research practice.
The core stance of the open letter can be summed up in one sentence: regulatory bodies should not restrict the development of open-source models to prevent potential risks that have not yet occurred.

Microsoft (MSFT-US) CEO Satya Nadella, Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk, Turing Award winner Yann LeCun, and AI expert Andrew Ng, among others, have signed the open letter, making it one of the largest collective statements in the AI community in recent years.
The signatories' motivations are varied, with each having their own commercial considerations.
Chip and hardware manufacturers like NVIDIA and Dell (DELL-US) are concerned about whether the demand for computing power will continue to grow.

Microsoft, Palantir (PLTR-US), and other cloud service and enterprise software providers hope to enrich their cloud platforms with open-source models, allowing customers to avoid being locked into a single API provider and keeping customers within their cloud and subscription services ecosystem.

The open-source camp, led by Meta (META-US), hopes to control the standards of technology through open models (such as the Llama series); startups like Mistral and Hugging Face also seek to win over customers from closed-source giants.

Venture capital firms like a16z and YC are concerned that if the underlying models are controlled by a few closed-source companies, the profit space for application-layer startups will be significantly compressed, so they support open-source to ensure that startups have room for negotiation on costs and business models.
